decisions.choice: chapter 23: the allegory of two sisters, Samaria and Jerusalem, pictured as unfaithful wives
decisions.reason: The chapter tells the history of the northern kingdom (Samaria) and of Judah (Jerusalem) as the story of two sisters whom the LORD married and who were unfaithful to him. Their "lovers" are the great powers Egypt, Assyria and Babylon, whose help and whose gods they sought instead of trusting the LORD. Chapter 16 tells Jerusalem's story in the same way, and Jeremiah 3:6-11 already compared the two sisters. The picture belongs to the prophets' long use of marriage for the covenant between God and his people (Hosea 1-3; Jeremiah 2:2). The language is sexually explicit and the punishments are violent; it is meant to shock the hearers into seeing their betrayal of God.

decisions.choice: Literal follows the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable state the meaning plainly and soberly, adding no detail; the chapter is marked for careful human review
alternatives: softening the language until the meaning is hidden
making it coarser than the Hebrew

decisions.choice: their breasts were pressed: the loss of their innocence while young

decisions.choice: Oholah and Oholibah: "her tent" and "my tent is in her"
alternatives: both names meaning simply "tent", with no further point
decisions.reason: Both names come from the word for "tent", which can mean a shrine (the tent of meeting). Oholah means "her tent" and Oholibah "my tent is in her". The names may point to the difference between Samaria, which had shrines of its own making, and Jerusalem, where the LORD's own house stood. They may also recall the tent shrines of idol worship (16:16). The names are kept, and their meaning is given here.

decisions.choice: the older: Samaria, the larger and earlier kingdom
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom was larger than Judah, and its fall came first (verses 9-10). In 16:46 Samaria is also called Jerusalem's "older sister".

decisions.choice: they became mine: God's marriage to his people
decisions.reason: To "become someone's" is to become his wife (Ruth 1:12-13; Ezekiel 16:8). Their sons and daughters are the people of the two kingdoms. That one man should marry two sisters was forbidden by Leviticus 18:18; the picture is not a rule for marriage but a way of speaking about two kingdoms that came from one people.

decisions.choice: her lovers, the Assyrians: the northern kingdom's dealings with Assyria
decisions.reason: Kings of Israel paid tribute to Assyria and sought its favor: Menahem gave silver to Pul (Tiglath-pileser III) to secure his throne (2 Kings 15:19-20), and Hoshea became Assyria's vassal (2 Kings 17:3). Hosea charges Ephraim with going to Assyria for help (Hosea 5:13; 8:9).

alternatives: prostituted herself while mine; lusted after
decisions.reason: The verb follows the wording set for Ezekiel: "prostitute oneself" at Literal and Balanced, and "be unfaithful, like a woman with many lovers" at Readable (see 16:1). The noun follows it: "prostitution" (L, B), "unfaithfulness" (R). "Lusted after" is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "longed for", which keeps the sense of strong desire in plain words. The comma at Literal shows that the sentence runs on into verse 6.

decisions.choice: lusted: 욕정을 품다 (L, B); 몹시 원하다 (R)
decisions.reason: The plain word for desire that is sexual; Readable softens it as the English R "longed for" does.

source.text: לְבֻשֵׁ֤י תְכֵ֨לֶת֙ פַּח֣וֹת וּסְגָנִ֔ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּ֑ם פָּרָשִׁ֕ים רֹכְבֵ֖י סוּסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, young men of desire all of them, horsemen riding horses.

en.L: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, desirable young men all of them, horsemen riding on horses.
en.B: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, horsemen mounted on horses.
en.R: They wore fine blue uniforms. They were governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men riding on horses.

fr.L: vêtus de pourpre bleue, gouverneurs et commandants, jeunes hommes désirables, tous, cavaliers montés sur des chevaux.
fr.B: vêtus de pourpre bleue, gouverneurs et commandants, tous de beaux jeunes gens, des cavaliers montés sur des chevaux.
fr.R: Ils portaient de beaux uniformes bleus. C’étaient des gouverneurs et des commandants, tous de beaux jeunes gens qui montaient à cheval.

es.L: vestidos de azul, gobernadores y comandantes, jóvenes deseables todos ellos, jinetes que montaban a caballo.
es.B: vestidos de azul, gobernadores y comandantes, todos ellos jóvenes apuestos, jinetes montados a caballo.
es.R: Llevaban finos uniformes azules. Eran gobernadores y comandantes, todos ellos jóvenes apuestos que montaban a caballo.

sw.L: waliovaa nguo za samawati, maliwali na majemadari, wote vijana wa kutamanika, wapanda farasi waliopanda farasi.
sw.B: waliovaa nguo za samawati, maliwali na majemadari, wote vijana wazuri wa sura, wapanda farasi.
sw.R: Walivaa sare nzuri za samawati. Walikuwa maliwali na majemadari, wote vijana wazuri wa sura waliopanda farasi.

ko.L: [그들은] 청색 옷을 입은 총독들과 지휘관들, 모두 탐스러운 젊은이들, 말을 탄 기병들이었다.
ko.B: 그들은 청색 옷을 입은 총독들과 지휘관들이었고, 모두 잘생긴 젊은이들이었으며, 말을 탄 기병들이었다.
ko.R: 그들은 멋진 푸른색 군복을 입고 있었다. 그들은 총독들과 지휘관들이었고, 모두 말을 탄 잘생긴 젊은이들이었다.

decisions.choice: blue clothing, governors and commanders: the splendor of Assyria's officials
decisions.reason: Blue or violet dye was costly, worn by the rich and powerful (Jeremiah 10:9). The words for "governor" and "commander" are titles of officials in the Assyrian and Babylonian empires. To the small kingdoms of Israel they looked impressive and attractive.

decisions.choice: desirable young men: the attraction of foreign power
decisions.reason: The picture is of a woman drawn by the looks of her lovers; the reality is a nation drawn by the might of an empire. The same words return in verses 12 and 23.

source.text: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן תַּזְנוּתֶ֨יהָ֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מִבְחַ֥ר בְּנֵֽי־אַשּׁ֖וּר כֻּלָּ֑ם וּבְכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־עָֽגְבָ֛ה בְּכָל־גִּלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם נִטְמָֽאָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And she gave her prostitutions to them, the choicest of the sons of Assyria, all of them; and with all whom she lusted after, with all their idols she defiled herself.

en.L: And she gave her prostitution to them, the choicest of the sons of Assyria, all of them; and with all after whom she lusted, with all their filthy idols, she defiled herself.
en.B: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, to all the elite of Assyria, and she defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.
en.R: She gave herself to all of them, the best men of Assyria. She made herself unclean with the idols of all the men she longed for.

fr.L: Et elle leur a donné ses prostitutions, l’élite des fils d’Assour, eux tous ; et avec tous ceux qu’elle désirait ardemment, avec toutes leurs idoles immondes, elle s’est souillée.
fr.B: Elle s’est livrée comme une prostituée à eux, à toute l’élite de l’Assyrie, et elle s’est souillée avec toutes les idoles de tous ceux qu’elle désirait.
fr.R: Elle s’est donnée à eux tous, les meilleurs hommes d’Assyrie. Elle s’est rendue impure avec les idoles de tous les hommes qu’elle désirait.

es.L: Y les entregó sus prostituciones, a lo más escogido de los hijos de Asiria, a todos ellos; y con todos aquellos por quienes se apasionó, con todos sus ídolos inmundos, se contaminó.
es.B: Se entregó como prostituta a ellos, a toda la élite de Asiria, y se contaminó con todos los ídolos de todos aquellos por quienes se apasionó.
es.R: Se entregó a todos ellos, a los mejores hombres de Asiria. Se hizo impura con los ídolos de todos los hombres que deseaba.

sw.L: Naye akawapa ukahaba wake, wateule wa wana wa Ashuru wote; na kwa wote aliowatamani, kwa sanamu zao zote chafu, alijitia unajisi.
sw.B: Alijitoa kwao kama kahaba, kwa wakuu wote wa Ashuru, naye akajitia unajisi kwa sanamu zote za kila mtu aliyemtamani.
sw.R: Alijitoa kwa wote hao, watu bora wa Ashuru. Alijifanya najisi kwa sanamu za wanaume wote aliowaonea shauku.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 그들, 곧 앗시리아 자손 가운데 가장 뛰어난 자들 모두에게 자기 음행을 바쳤고, 자기가 욕정을 품은 모든 자들과 함께, 그들의 모든 더러운 우상들로 자기를 더럽혔다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 앗시리아의 가장 뛰어난 자들 모두에게 몸을 내주며 음행했고, 자기가 욕정을 품은 모든 자의 우상들로 자기를 더럽혔다.
ko.R: 그 여자는 앗시리아의 가장 뛰어난 남자들 모두에게 몸을 내주었다. 그 여자는 자기가 원한 모든 남자의 우상들로 자기를 더럽혔다.

decisions.choice: with their idols she defiled herself: alliances brought foreign gods
decisions.reason: Political ties with an empire often meant honoring its gods. The northern kingdom's worship of other gods is set out in 2 Kings 17:7-17.

decisions.choice: gave herself as a prostitute (B); gave herself (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew noun; Balanced turns it into a plain verb phrase. Readable says only that she gave herself to them, since the whole verse already says what kind of giving is meant.

source.text: וְאֶת־תַּזְנוּתֶ֤יהָ מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔בָה כִּ֤י אוֹתָהּ֙ שָׁכְב֣וּ בִנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וְהֵ֥מָּה עִשּׂ֖וּ דַּדֵּ֣י בְתוּלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּשְׁפְּכ֥וּ תַזְנוּתָ֖ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And her prostitutions from Egypt she did not abandon, for with her they lay in her youth, and they handled [the] breasts of her virginity, and they poured out their lust on her.

en.L: And her prostitution from Egypt she did not give up, for they lay with her in her youth, and they handled the breasts of her virginity, and they poured out their lust on her.
en.B: She did not give up the prostitution she had begun in Egypt, for in her youth men lay with her, fondled her breasts while she was still a virgin and poured out their lust on her.
en.R: She did not stop the unfaithfulness she had begun in Egypt. When she was young, men there had sex with her. They touched her breasts while she was a virgin and satisfied their lust with her.

fr.L: Et ses prostitutions d’Égypte, elle ne les a pas abandonnées, car ils avaient couché avec elle dans sa jeunesse, et ils avaient caressé les seins de sa virginité, et ils avaient répandu sur elle leur débauche.
fr.B: Elle n’a pas renoncé à la prostitution commencée en Égypte, car dans sa jeunesse des hommes avaient couché avec elle, avaient caressé ses seins quand elle était encore vierge et avaient assouvi sur elle leur désir.
fr.R: Elle n’a pas arrêté l’infidélité qu’elle avait commencée en Égypte. Quand elle était jeune, des hommes de là-bas avaient couché avec elle. Ils avaient touché ses seins alors qu’elle était vierge et avaient satisfait leur désir avec elle.

es.L: Y sus prostituciones de Egipto no dejó, porque con ella se acostaron en su juventud, y ellos acariciaron los pechos de su virginidad, y derramaron sobre ella su lujuria.
es.B: No abandonó la prostitución que había comenzado en Egipto, porque en su juventud los hombres se acostaron con ella, le acariciaron los pechos cuando aún era virgen y derramaron sobre ella su lujuria.
es.R: No dejó la infidelidad que había comenzado en Egipto. Cuando era joven, los hombres de allí tuvieron relaciones sexuales con ella. Le tocaron los pechos cuando era virgen y satisficieron con ella su lujuria.

sw.L: Wala hakuuacha ukahaba wake wa tangu Misri, kwa maana walilala naye katika ujana wake, wakayashika matiti ya ubikira wake, wakamwagia tamaa yao.
sw.B: Hakuuacha ukahaba aliouanza Misri, kwa maana katika ujana wake wanaume walilala naye, wakayapapasa matiti yake akiwa bado bikira, na kummwagia tamaa yao.
sw.R: Hakuacha kutokuwa mwaminifu kama alivyoanza Misri. Alipokuwa msichana mdogo, wanaume wa huko walilala naye. Walimgusa matiti akiwa bado bikira na kutimiza tamaa yao kwake.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 이집트에서부터 해 온 자기 음행을 버리지 않았다. 그 여자가 젊었을 때 그들이 그 여자와 함께 누웠고, 그 여자의 처녀 시절의 가슴을 만졌으며, 그 여자 위에 자기들의 음욕을 쏟았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 이집트에서 시작한 음행을 그만두지 않았다. 그 여자가 젊었을 때 남자들이 그 여자와 동침했고, 처녀였던 그 여자의 가슴을 주물렀으며, 그 여자에게 자기들의 음욕을 쏟았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그 여자는 이집트에서 시작한 신실하지 못한 짓을 그만두지 않았다. 그 여자가 젊었을 때 거기서 남자들이 그 여자와 성관계를 가졌다. 그들은 처녀였던 그 여자의 가슴을 만졌고, 그 여자에게서 자기들의 욕정을 채웠다.

decisions.choice: her prostitution from Egypt: the northern kingdom's ties with Egypt
decisions.reason: Jeroboam I, who founded the northern kingdom, had lived in Egypt (1 Kings 11:40), and his golden calves recalled the calf made at Sinai (1 Kings 12:28; Exodus 32:4). The last king, Hoshea, sent to Egypt for help against Assyria (2 Kings 17:4; Hosea 7:11).

decisions.choice: plain and sober wording
decisions.reason: "Lay with her" is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "had sex with her", which is plain without being coarse. The rest follows verse 3.

source.text: לָכֵ֥ן נְתַתִּ֖יהָ בְּיַד־מְאַֽהֲבֶ֑יהָ בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָגְבָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I gave her into [the] hand of her lovers, into [the] hand of [the] sons of Assyria, after whom she lusted.

en.L: Therefore I have given her into the hand of her lovers, the hand of the sons of Assyria, after whom she lusted.
en.B: So I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians she lusted after.
en.R: So I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians she had longed for.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je l’ai livrée entre les mains de ses amants, entre les mains des fils d’Assour, qu’elle désirait ardemment.
fr.B: Alors je l’ai livrée à ses amants, les Assyriens qu’elle désirait.
fr.R: Alors je l’ai livrée à ses amants, les Assyriens qu’elle avait désirés.

es.L: Por tanto, la he entregado en mano de sus amantes, en mano de los hijos de Asiria, por quienes se había apasionado.
es.B: Por eso la entregué en manos de sus amantes, los asirios, por quienes se apasionaba.
es.R: Por eso la entregué a sus amantes, los asirios que tanto había deseado.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nimemtia mkononi mwa wapenzi wake, mkononi mwa wana wa Ashuru, aliowatamani.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nilimtia mikononi mwa wapenzi wake, Waashuru aliowatamani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilimtia mikononi mwa wapenzi wake, Waashuru aliokuwa amewaonea shauku.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 그 여자를 그 애인들의 손에, 곧 그 여자가 욕정을 품은 앗시리아 자손의 손에 넘겨주었다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 그 여자를 그 애인들, 곧 그 여자가 욕정을 품었던 앗시리아 사람들에게 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 그 여자를 그 애인들, 곧 그 여자가 몹시 원했던 앗시리아 사람들에게 넘겨주었다.

decisions.choice: handed over to her lovers: the power she courted became her destroyer
decisions.reason: The empire Israel tried to please was the one that destroyed it. God's judgment works through the very thing his people chose instead of him.

source.text: הֵמָּה֮ גִּלּ֣וּ עֶרְוָתָהּ֒ בָּנֶ֤יהָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ לָקָ֔חוּ וְאוֹתָ֖הּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב הָרָ֑גוּ וַתְּהִי־שֵׁם֙ לַנָּשִׁ֔ים וּשְׁפוּטִ֖ים עָ֥שׂוּ בָֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: They uncovered her nakedness; her sons and her daughters they took, and her with the sword they killed; and she became a name among women, and judgments they executed on her.

en.L: They uncovered her nakedness; her sons and her daughters they took, and her they killed with the sword; and she became a byword among women, and they executed judgments on her.
en.B: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, because of the judgments carried out on her.
en.R: They stripped her naked. They took away her sons and daughters as captives. They killed her with the sword. Women everywhere talked about her, because of the way she was punished.

fr.L: Ils ont découvert sa nudité ; ses fils et ses filles, ils les ont pris, et elle, ils l’ont tuée par l’épée ; et elle est devenue un nom parmi les femmes, et ils ont exécuté sur elle des jugements.
fr.B: Ils l’ont mise à nu, ont emmené ses fils et ses filles et l’ont tuée par l’épée. Elle est devenue un exemple dont parlaient les femmes, à cause des châtiments exécutés contre elle.
fr.R: Ils l’ont déshabillée. Ils ont emmené ses fils et ses filles comme prisonniers. Ils l’ont tuée avec l’épée. Partout, les femmes parlaient d’elle, à cause de la façon dont elle avait été punie.

es.L: Ellos descubrieron su desnudez; a sus hijos y a sus hijas tomaron, y a ella la mataron a espada; y llegó a ser un escarmiento entre las mujeres, y ejecutaron juicios contra ella.
es.B: La desnudaron, se llevaron a sus hijos y a sus hijas y a ella la mataron a espada. Llegó a ser tema de habladurías entre las mujeres, por los castigos que se ejecutaron contra ella.
es.R: La desnudaron. Se llevaron cautivos a sus hijos y a sus hijas. A ella la mataron a espada. Las mujeres de todas partes hablaban de ella por la forma en que fue castigada.

sw.L: Wao waliufunua uchi wake; wana wake na binti zake wakawachukua, naye wakamwua kwa upanga; naye akawa methali kati ya wanawake, nao wakatekeleza hukumu juu yake.
sw.B: Walimvua nguo akabaki uchi, wakawachukua wana wake na binti zake, wakamwua kwa upanga. Akawa methali kati ya wanawake kwa sababu ya hukumu iliyotekelezwa juu yake.
sw.R: Walimvua nguo akabaki uchi. Wakawachukua wana wake na binti zake kuwa mateka. Wakamwua kwa upanga. Wanawake kila mahali walimzungumzia kwa sababu ya jinsi alivyoadhibiwa.

ko.L: 그들이 그 여자의 벗은 몸을 드러냈고, 그 여자의 아들들과 딸들을 빼앗았으며, 그 여자를 칼로 죽였다. 그래서 그 여자는 여자들 사이에 이야깃거리가 되었고, 그들이 그 여자에게 심판을 행했다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 여자의 옷을 벗겨 알몸이 되게 하고, 그 아들딸들을 빼앗아 가고, 그 여자를 칼로 죽였다. 그 여자에게 내려진 심판 때문에 그 여자는 여자들 사이에 본보기로 이야기되었다.
ko.R: 그들은 그 여자의 옷을 벗겨 알몸이 되게 했다. 그들은 그 여자의 아들딸들을 포로로 끌고 갔다. 그들은 그 여자를 칼로 죽였다. 그 여자가 받은 벌 때문에 곳곳의 여자들이 그 여자에 대해 이야기했다.

decisions.choice: the fall of Samaria: its people killed and carried into exile
decisions.reason: Assyria besieged Samaria for three years and took it in 722 BC; its people were deported to Assyria and other lands (2 Kings 17:5-6; 18:9-11).

decisions.choice: they uncovered her nakedness: public shaming
decisions.reason: A woman punished for adultery could be stripped in public (16:37-39; Hosea 2:5, 12), and captives were led away naked (Isaiah 20:4). The picture joins both.

decisions.choice: a name among women: a byword, an example everyone talks about
decisions.reason: To become a "name" here is to become notorious, an example used as a warning.

decisions.choice: as captives
decisions.reason: Readable says why the children were taken (m1).

source.text: וַתֵּ֨רֶא֙ אֲחוֹתָ֣הּ אָהֳלִיבָ֔ה וַתַּשְׁחֵ֥ת עַגְבָתָ֖הּ מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְאֶת־תַּ֨זְנוּתֶ֔יהָ מִזְּנוּנֵ֖י אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw her sister Oholibah, and she was more corrupt in her lust than she, and her prostitutions more than [the] prostitutions of her sister.

en.L: And her sister Oholibah saw [it], and she became more corrupt in her lust than she, and in her prostitution [more] than the prostitution of her sister.
en.B: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was even more depraved in her lust than Oholah, and her prostitution was worse than her sister's.
en.R: Her sister Oholibah saw all this. But she became even more full of lust than her sister. She was even more unfaithful than her sister had been.

fr.L: Et sa sœur Oholiba [l’]a vu, et elle a été plus corrompue qu’elle dans son désir, et dans ses prostitutions, [plus] que les prostitutions de sa sœur.
fr.B: Sa sœur Oholiba a vu cela, et pourtant elle a été encore plus dépravée qu’Ohola dans son désir, et ses prostitutions ont été pires que celles de sa sœur.
fr.R: Sa sœur Oholiba a vu tout cela. Mais elle est devenue encore plus pleine de désir que sa sœur. Elle a été encore plus infidèle que sa sœur ne l’avait été.

es.L: Y lo vio su hermana Aholibá, y se corrompió en su pasión más que ella, y en sus prostituciones [más] que las prostituciones de su hermana.
es.B: Su hermana Aholibá vio esto, y aun así fue más depravada que Aholá en su pasión, y su prostitución fue peor que la de su hermana.
es.R: Su hermana Aholibá vio todo esto. Pero su lujuria fue aún mayor que la de su hermana. Fue todavía más infiel de lo que había sido su hermana.

sw.L: Na dada yake Oholiba akaona [hayo], naye akaharibika kuliko yeye katika tamaa yake, na katika ukahaba wake [kuliko] ukahaba wa dada yake.
sw.B: Dada yake Oholiba aliona hayo, lakini yeye akawa mpotovu zaidi katika tamaa yake kuliko Ohola, na ukahaba wake ukawa mbaya kuliko wa dada yake.
sw.R: Dada yake Oholiba aliyaona hayo yote. Lakini yeye akajaa tamaa kuliko dada yake. Akawa si mwaminifu hata kuliko dada yake alivyokuwa.

ko.L: 그 여자의 자매 오홀리바가 [이것을] 보았으나, 자기 욕정에서 그 여자보다 더 타락했고, 자기 음행에서 자기 언니의 음행보다 [더했다].
ko.B: 그 동생 오홀리바는 이것을 보고도 오홀라보다 더 타락하여 욕정에 빠졌고, 언니보다 더 심하게 음행했다.
ko.R: 오홀리바는 언니에게 일어난 이 모든 일을 보았다. 그런데도 언니보다 더 욕정에 빠졌다. 오홀리바는 언니보다 훨씬 더 신실하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: her sister saw, yet did worse: as Jeremiah 3:7-8 and Ezekiel 16:47-51
decisions.reason: Jeremiah says that Judah saw what happened to faithless Israel and still was not afraid. Ezekiel 16:51 says that Samaria did not commit half of Jerusalem's sins. Judah had a warning before its eyes and did not heed it.

source.text: אֶל־בְּנֵי֩ אַשּׁ֨וּר עָגָ֜בָה פַּח֨וֹת וּסְגָנִ֤ים קְרֹבִים֙ לְבֻשֵׁ֣י מִכְל֔וֹל פָּרָשִׁ֖ים רֹכְבֵ֣י סוּסִ֑ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: After [the] sons of Assyria she lusted, governors and commanders, warriors clothed in full splendor, horsemen riding horses, young men of desire all of them.

en.L: After the sons of Assyria she lusted, governors and commanders, warriors clothed in full splendor, horsemen riding on horses, desirable young men all of them.
en.B: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and commanders, warriors in splendid dress, horsemen mounted on horses, all of them handsome young men.
en.R: She longed for the Assyrians. They were governors and commanders, soldiers in fine uniforms, horsemen riding on horses. All of them were handsome young men.

fr.L: Les fils d’Assour, elle les a désirés ardemment, gouverneurs et commandants, guerriers vêtus avec magnificence, cavaliers montés sur des chevaux, jeunes hommes désirables, tous.
fr.B: Elle a brûlé de désir pour les Assyriens, gouverneurs et commandants, guerriers aux vêtements splendides, cavaliers montés sur des chevaux, tous de beaux jeunes gens.
fr.R: Elle a désiré les Assyriens. C’étaient des gouverneurs et des commandants, des soldats en beaux uniformes, des cavaliers qui montaient à cheval. Tous étaient de beaux jeunes gens.

es.L: Por los hijos de Asiria se apasionó, gobernadores y comandantes, guerreros vestidos con todo esplendor, jinetes que montaban a caballo, jóvenes deseables todos ellos.
es.B: Se apasionó por los asirios, gobernadores y comandantes, guerreros espléndidamente vestidos, jinetes montados a caballo, todos ellos jóvenes apuestos.
es.R: Deseó a los asirios. Eran gobernadores y comandantes, soldados con finos uniformes, jinetes que montaban a caballo. Todos ellos eran jóvenes apuestos.

sw.L: Aliwatamani wana wa Ashuru, maliwali na majemadari, mashujaa waliovaa mavazi ya fahari kamili, wapanda farasi waliopanda farasi, wote vijana wa kutamanika.
sw.B: Aliwatamani Waashuru, maliwali na majemadari, askari waliovaa mavazi ya fahari, wapanda farasi, wote vijana wazuri wa sura.
sw.R: Aliwaonea shauku Waashuru. Walikuwa maliwali na majemadari, askari waliovaa sare nzuri, wapanda farasi. Wote walikuwa vijana wazuri wa sura.

ko.L: 그 여자는 앗시리아 자손, 곧 총독들과 지휘관들, 화려하게 차려입은 용사들, 말을 탄 기병들, 모두 탐스러운 젊은이들에게 욕정을 품었다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 앗시리아 사람들에게 욕정을 품었다. 그들은 총독들과 지휘관들이었고, 화려한 옷을 입은 용사들이었으며, 말을 탄 기병들이었고, 모두 잘생긴 젊은이들이었다.
ko.R: 오홀리바는 앗시리아 사람들을 몹시 원했다. 그들은 총독들과 지휘관들이었고, 멋진 군복을 입은 군인들이었으며, 말을 탄 기병들이었다. 그들은 모두 잘생긴 젊은이들이었다.

decisions.choice: Judah and Assyria: King Ahaz's appeal to Tiglath-pileser
decisions.reason: When Judah was attacked by Aram and Israel, King Ahaz sent silver and gold to the king of Assyria, called himself his servant, and copied an altar he saw in Damascus (2 Kings 16:7-18; Isaiah 7).

decisions.choice: clothed in full splendor: in magnificent dress
decisions.reason: The phrase is used again of the army in 38:4. The words of verse 6 are repeated: Judah fell for the same show of power.

source.text: וָאֵ֖רֶא כִּ֣י נִטְמָ֑אָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw that she was defiled; one way [was] for the two of them.

en.L: And I saw that she was defiled; [there was] one way for the two of them.
en.B: I saw that she had defiled herself; both of them went the same way.
en.R: I saw that she had made herself unclean. Both sisters had done the same thing.

fr.L: Et j’ai vu qu’elle s’était souillée ; [il y avait] un même chemin pour elles deux.
fr.B: J’ai vu qu’elle s’était souillée ; toutes deux suivaient le même chemin.
fr.R: J’ai vu qu’elle s’était rendue impure. Les deux sœurs avaient fait la même chose.

es.L: Y vi que se había contaminado; un mismo camino [tenían] las dos.
es.B: Vi que se había contaminado; las dos siguieron el mismo camino.
es.R: Vi que se había hecho impura. Las dos hermanas habían hecho lo mismo.

sw.L: Nami nikaona kwamba ametiwa unajisi; [ilikuwa] njia moja kwa wote wawili.
sw.B: Niliona kwamba alikuwa amejitia unajisi; wote wawili walifuata njia ile ile.
sw.R: Niliona kwamba alikuwa amejifanya najisi. Dada wote wawili walikuwa wamefanya jambo lile lile.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그 여자가 더럽혀진 것을 보았다. 그 둘에게 한 길이 [있었다].
ko.B: 나는 그 여자가 자기를 더럽힌 것을 보았다. 두 자매는 같은 길을 갔다.
ko.R: 나는 오홀리바가 자기를 더럽힌 것을 보았다. 두 자매는 똑같은 짓을 했다.

decisions.choice: one way for both: the same conduct
decisions.reason: A "way" is a way of life. Both sisters lived the same way, and so both would come to the same end (verse 31).

source.text: וַתּ֖וֹסֶף אֶל־תַּזְנוּתֶ֑יהָ וַתֵּ֗רֶא אַנְשֵׁי֙ מְחֻקֶּ֣ה עַל־הַקִּ֔יר צַלְמֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים חֲקֻקִ֖ים בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃

records.literal_gloss: And she added to her prostitutions; and she saw men carved on the wall, images of Chaldeans carved in vermilion,

en.L: And she increased her prostitution; she saw men carved on the wall, images of the Chaldeans engraved in vermilion,
en.B: But she carried her prostitution further. She saw men pictured on a wall, figures of Chaldeans drawn in red,
en.R: But she became even more unfaithful. She saw pictures of men on a wall, pictures of Babylonians painted in bright red.

fr.L: Et elle a ajouté à ses prostitutions ; elle a vu des hommes gravés sur le mur, des images de Chaldéens gravées au vermillon,
fr.B: Mais elle est allée plus loin dans sa prostitution. Elle a vu des hommes représentés sur un mur, des images de Chaldéens dessinées en rouge,
fr.R: Mais elle est devenue encore plus infidèle. Elle a vu sur un mur des images d’hommes, des images de Babyloniens peintes en rouge vif.

es.L: Y aumentó sus prostituciones; vio hombres grabados en la pared, imágenes de caldeos pintadas de bermellón,
es.B: Pero llevó más lejos su prostitución. Vio hombres pintados en una pared, figuras de caldeos dibujadas en rojo,
es.R: Pero se volvió aún más infiel. Vio en una pared imágenes de hombres, imágenes de babilonios pintadas de rojo brillante.

sw.L: Naye akaongeza ukahaba wake; akaona wanaume waliochorwa ukutani, sanamu za Wakaldayo zilizochorwa kwa rangi nyekundu,
sw.B: Lakini aliuendeleza ukahaba wake zaidi. Aliona wanaume waliochorwa ukutani, picha za Wakaldayo zilizochorwa kwa rangi nyekundu,
sw.R: Lakini akazidi kutokuwa mwaminifu. Aliona picha za wanaume ukutani, picha za Wababeli zilizopakwa rangi nyekundu nyangavu.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 자기 음행을 더했다. 그 여자는 벽에 새겨진 남자들, 붉은색으로 새긴 갈대아 사람들의 형상을 보았다.
ko.B: 그런데 그 여자는 음행을 더 심하게 했다. 그 여자는 벽에 그려진 남자들, 붉은색으로 그린 갈대아 사람들의 모습을 보았다.
ko.R: 그런데 오홀리바는 더욱 신실하지 않게 되었다. 그 여자는 벽에 그려진 남자들의 그림, 밝은 붉은색으로 칠한 바빌로니아 사람들의 그림을 보았다.

decisions.choice: men carved on the wall in vermilion: pictures of Babylonian officers
decisions.reason: Babylonian and Assyrian palaces were decorated with carved and painted reliefs of kings and soldiers. Vermilion, a bright red paint, was used for decoration (Jeremiah 22:14). Seeing such pictures, or hearing of Babylon's glory, Judah was drawn to it.

decisions.choice: Babylonians
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans are "Babylonians" at Readable, as set for the prophets. The comma at Literal and Balanced shows that the sentence runs on into verse 15.

decisions.choice: "les Chaldéens" (L, B); "les Babyloniens" (R), and "la Chaldée" (L, B), "la Babylonie" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled French wording for the Chaldeans in the prophets.

source.text: חֲגוֹרֵ֨י אֵז֜וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶ֗ם סְרוּחֵ֤י טְבוּלִים֙ בְּרָ֣אשֵׁיהֶ֔ם מַרְאֵ֥ה שָׁלִשִׁ֖ים כֻּלָּ֑ם דְּמ֤וּת בְּנֵֽי־בָבֶל֙ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֶ֖רֶץ מוֹלַדְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: girded with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, [the] appearance of officers all of them, [the] likeness of [the] sons of Babylon, Chaldea [being the] land of their birth.

en.L: girded with belts around their waists, with turbans hanging down on their heads, all of them with the appearance of officers, the likeness of the sons of Babylon, whose native land [is] Chaldea.
en.B: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like officers, like the Babylonians whose native land is Chaldea.
en.R: They had belts around their waists and long turbans on their heads. All of them looked like army officers from Babylon, the land of the Babylonians.

fr.L: ceints de ceintures autour des reins, avec des turbans flottants sur la tête, tous ayant l’aspect d’officiers, la ressemblance des fils de Babylone, dont le pays natal [est] la Chaldée,
fr.B: avec des ceintures autour de la taille et des turbans flottants sur la tête, tous ayant l’air d’officiers, semblables aux Babyloniens dont le pays natal est la Chaldée.
fr.R: Ils avaient des ceintures autour de la taille et de longs turbans sur la tête. Tous ressemblaient à des officiers de l’armée de Babylone, le pays des Babyloniens.

es.L: ceñidos con cinturones en sus lomos, con turbantes colgantes en sus cabezas, todos ellos con aspecto de oficiales, a semejanza de los hijos de Babilonia, cuya tierra natal [es] Caldea,
es.B: con cinturones en la cintura y turbantes colgantes en la cabeza, todos ellos con aspecto de oficiales, como los babilonios cuya tierra natal es Caldea.
es.R: Tenían cinturones en la cintura y largos turbantes en la cabeza. Todos parecían oficiales del ejército de Babilonia, la tierra de los babilonios.

sw.L: wamefungwa mikanda viunoni mwao, na vilemba vinavyoning'inia vichwani mwao, wote wakiwa na sura ya maafisa, mfano wa wana wa Babeli, ambao nchi ya kuzaliwa kwao [ni] Ukaldayo.
sw.B: wakiwa na mikanda viunoni na vilemba virefu vichwani, wote wakionekana kama maafisa, kama Wababeli ambao nchi yao ya kuzaliwa ni Ukaldayo.
sw.R: Walikuwa na mikanda viunoni na vilemba virefu vichwani. Wote walionekana kama maafisa wa jeshi kutoka Babeli, nchi ya Wababeli.

ko.L: 그들은 허리에 띠를 띠고 머리에는 늘어진 두건을 썼으며, 모두 장교의 모습이었고, 바빌론 자손의 형상이었으니, 갈대아가 그들의 고향 땅이다.
ko.B: 그들은 허리에 띠를 두르고 머리에 늘어진 두건을 썼으며, 모두 장교처럼 보였다. 그들은 갈대아가 고향인 바빌론 사람들의 모습이었다.
ko.R: 그들은 허리에 띠를 두르고 머리에 긴 두건을 쓰고 있었다. 그들은 모두 바빌로니아 사람들의 땅인 바빌론에서 온 군대 장교들처럼 보였다.

decisions.choice: officers: high-ranking soldiers
alternatives: the third man in a chariot
decisions.reason: The word comes from the number "three" and may first have meant the third man in a war chariot. It came to mean a senior officer (2 Kings 7:2; 9:25).

decisions.choice: flowing turbans: hanging headdresses
decisions.reason: The word describes a headdress with hanging folds or loose ends. The exact style is not certain.

source.text: וַתַּעְגְּבָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַרְאֵ֣ה עֵינֶ֑יהָ וַתִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כַּשְׂדִּֽימָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And she lusted after them at [the] sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them to Chaldea.

en.L: And she lusted after them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
en.B: The moment her eyes fell on them, she lusted after them, and she sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
en.R: As soon as she saw them, she longed for them. She sent messengers to them in Babylonia.

fr.L: Et elle les a désirés ardemment dès que ses yeux les ont vus, et elle leur a envoyé des messagers en Chaldée.
fr.B: Dès que ses yeux se sont posés sur eux, elle a brûlé de désir pour eux, et elle leur a envoyé des messagers en Chaldée.
fr.R: Dès qu’elle les a vus, elle les a désirés. Elle leur a envoyé des messagers en Babylonie.

es.L: Y se apasionó por ellos al verlos sus ojos, y les envió mensajeros a Caldea.
es.B: En cuanto sus ojos los vieron, se apasionó por ellos y les envió mensajeros a Caldea.
es.R: En cuanto los vio, los deseó. Les envió mensajeros a Babilonia.

sw.L: Naye akawatamani alipowaona kwa macho yake, akatuma wajumbe kwao huko Ukaldayo.
sw.B: Mara macho yake yalipowaona, aliwatamani, akatuma wajumbe kwao huko Ukaldayo.
sw.R: Mara tu alipowaona, aliwaonea shauku. Akatuma wajumbe kwao huko Babeli.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 자기 눈으로 보자마자 그들에게 욕정을 품었고, 갈대아로 그들에게 사신들을 보냈다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 그들을 보자마자 욕정을 품고, 갈대아에 있는 그들에게 사신들을 보냈다.
ko.R: 오홀리바는 그들을 보자마자 그들을 몹시 원했다. 그 여자는 바빌로니아에 있는 그들에게 사신들을 보냈다.

decisions.choice: she sent messengers to Chaldea: Judah's dealings with Babylon
decisions.reason: Hezekiah welcomed envoys from Babylon and showed them his treasures (2 Kings 20:12-19). Later Judah's kings became Babylon's vassals: Jehoiakim served Nebuchadnezzar for three years (2 Kings 24:1), and Zedekiah was put on the throne by him (2 Kings 24:17).

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלֶ֤יהָ בְנֵֽי־בָבֶל֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ב דֹּדִ֔ים וַיְטַמְּא֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ בְּתַזְנוּתָ֑ם וַתִּ֨טְמָא־בָ֔ם וַתֵּ֥קַע נַפְשָׁ֖הּ מֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And came to her [the] sons of Babylon to [the] bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution; and she was defiled by them, and turned away her soul from them.

en.L: And the sons of Babylon came to her, to the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution; and she was defiled by them, and then her soul turned from them in disgust.
en.B: The Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and defiled her with their lust. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.
en.R: So the Babylonians came to her bed as her lovers. They made her unclean with their lust. After they had made her unclean, she turned away from them in disgust.

fr.L: Et les fils de Babylone sont venus vers elle, au lit des amours, et ils l’ont souillée par leur prostitution ; et elle a été souillée par eux, puis son âme s’est détachée d’eux avec dégoût.
fr.B: Les Babyloniens sont venus vers elle, dans le lit de l’amour, et l’ont souillée par leur désir. Après avoir été souillée par eux, elle s’est détournée d’eux avec dégoût.
fr.R: Alors les Babyloniens sont venus dans son lit comme amants. Ils l’ont rendue impure avec leur désir. Après qu’ils l’ont rendue impure, elle s’est détournée d’eux avec dégoût.

es.L: Y vinieron a ella los hijos de Babilonia, al lecho de amores, y la contaminaron con sus prostituciones; y ella se contaminó con ellos, y luego su alma se apartó de ellos con asco.
es.B: Los babilonios vinieron a ella, al lecho del amor, y la contaminaron con su lujuria. Después de haber sido contaminada por ellos, se apartó de ellos con asco.
es.R: Así que los babilonios vinieron a su cama como amantes. La hicieron impura con su lujuria. Después de que la hicieron impura, ella se apartó de ellos con asco.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Babeli wakaja kwake, kwenye kitanda cha mapenzi, wakamtia unajisi kwa ukahaba wao; naye akatiwa unajisi nao, kisha nafsi yake ikawachukia akajitenga nao.
sw.B: Wababeli walikuja kwake, kwenye kitanda cha mapenzi, wakamtia unajisi kwa tamaa yao. Baada ya kutiwa unajisi nao, aliwachukia akajitenga nao.
sw.R: Basi Wababeli walikuja kitandani kwake kama wapenzi wake. Wakamfanya najisi kwa tamaa yao. Baada ya kumfanya najisi, aliwachukia akajitenga nao.

ko.L: 그러자 바빌론 자손이 사랑의 침상으로 그 여자에게 왔고, 그들의 음행으로 그 여자를 더럽혔다. 그 여자는 그들로 말미암아 더럽혀졌고, 그 뒤에 그 여자의 마음이 그들에게서 싫증 나 떠났다.
ko.B: 바빌론 사람들이 사랑의 침상으로 그 여자에게 왔고, 자기들의 음욕으로 그 여자를 더럽혔다. 그 여자는 그들에게 더럽혀진 뒤에 그들이 역겨워져서 그들에게서 돌아섰다.
ko.R: 그래서 바빌로니아 사람들이 애인으로서 그 여자의 침대로 왔다. 그들은 자기들의 욕정으로 그 여자를 더럽혔다. 그들이 그 여자를 더럽힌 뒤에, 그 여자는 그들이 역겨워져서 그들에게서 돌아섰다.

decisions.choice: she turned from them in disgust: Judah's revolts against Babylon
decisions.reason: Jehoiakim rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar after three years (2 Kings 24:1), and Zedekiah rebelled in turn (2 Kings 24:20; Ezekiel 17:15), turning to Egypt for help (verse 19).

decisions.choice: turned away in disgust: a word for being torn away, alienated
decisions.reason: The verb means to be wrenched away or alienated. It is used three times in verses 17-18: Judah turns from Babylon, and the LORD turns from Judah, as he had turned from her sister.

decisions.choice: their lust
decisions.reason: The Hebrew noun is the one for prostitution, used here of the lovers. Balanced and Readable say "lust", which gives its sense in this place.

source.text: וַתְּגַל֙ תַּזְנוּתֶ֔יהָ וַתְּגַ֖ל אֶת־עֶרְוָתָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֤קַע נַפְשִׁי֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י מֵעַ֥ל אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And she uncovered her prostitutions and uncovered her nakedness; and my soul turned from her, as my soul had turned from her sister.

en.L: And she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness; and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul turned from her in disgust, as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul had turned from her sister.
en.B: When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, as I had turned away from her sister.
en.R: She was unfaithful openly and showed her naked body for all to see. So I turned from her in disgust, as I had done with her sister.

fr.L: Et elle a mis à nu ses prostitutions et elle a découvert sa nudité ; et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme s’est détachée d’elle avec dégoût, comme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme s’était détachée de sa sœur.
fr.B: Quand elle a étalé sa prostitution et exposé sa nudité, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis détourné d’elle avec dégoût, comme je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}étais détourné de sa sœur.
fr.R: Elle a été infidèle ouvertement et a montré son corps nu à tous. Alors je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis détourné d’elle avec dégoût, comme je l’avais fait avec sa sœur.

es.L: Y descubrió sus prostituciones y descubrió su desnudez; y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma se apartó de ella con asco, como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma se había apartado de su hermana.
es.B: Cuando siguió prostituyéndose abiertamente y mostró su desnudez, me aparté de ella con asco, como me había apartado de su hermana.
es.R: Fue infiel abiertamente y mostró su cuerpo desnudo a todos. Así que me aparté de ella con asco, como había hecho con su hermana.

sw.L: Naye akaufunua ukahaba wake na kuufunua uchi wake; nayo nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ikamchukia ikajitenga naye, kama nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ilivyomchukia dada yake.
sw.B: Alipoendelea na ukahaba wake waziwazi na kuuonyesha uchi wake, nilimchukia nikajitenga naye, kama nilivyomchukia dada yake nikajitenga naye.
sw.R: Hakuwa mwaminifu waziwazi, akauonyesha mwili wake uchi kila mtu auone. Kwa hiyo nilimchukia nikamwacha, kama nilivyomfanyia dada yake.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 자기 음행을 드러내고 자기 벗은 몸을 드러냈다. 그러자 내 마음이 그 여자에게서 싫증 나 떠났으니, 내 마음이 그 언니에게서 싫증 나 떠났던 것과 같았다.
ko.B: 그 여자가 드러내 놓고 음행하며 자기 알몸을 드러내자, 나는 그 언니에게서 역겨워 돌아섰던 것처럼 그 여자에게서도 역겨워 돌아섰다.
ko.R: 오홀리바는 드러내 놓고 신실하지 않게 살았고, 모든 사람이 보도록 자기 알몸을 드러냈다. 그래서 나는 그 언니에게 했던 것처럼 역겨워서 그 여자에게서 돌아섰다.

decisions.choice: my soul turned from her: God turns from Judah as Judah turned from Babylon
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 17 is used. Judah's restlessness from one ally to another ends with the LORD himself turning away, as he had from the northern kingdom (2 Kings 17:18-20).

decisions.choice: uncovered her nakedness: her unfaithfulness was open and shameless
decisions.reason: Here the woman herself exposes her shame, a picture of open and unashamed idolatry.

decisions.choice: I turned away
decisions.reason: "My soul" means "I myself"; Literal keeps it.

source.text: וַתַּרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת־תַּזְנוּתֶ֑יהָ לִזְכֹּר֙ אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָנְתָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And she multiplied her prostitutions, remembering [the] days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: Yet she increased her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.
en.B: Yet she prostituted herself more and more, remembering the days of her youth when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.
en.R: But she became more and more unfaithful. She remembered the days when she was young and was unfaithful in the land of Egypt.

fr.L: Et elle a multiplié ses prostitutions, se souvenant des jours de sa jeunesse, quand elle s’était prostituée au pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Pourtant elle s’est prostituée de plus en plus, se souvenant des jours de sa jeunesse, quand elle s’était prostituée au pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Mais elle est devenue de plus en plus infidèle. Elle se souvenait du temps où elle était jeune et où elle était infidèle au pays d’Égypte.

es.L: Pero multiplicó sus prostituciones, acordándose de los días de su juventud, cuando se prostituyó en la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: Pero se prostituyó cada vez más, recordando los días de su juventud, cuando se prostituyó en la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: Pero fue cada vez más infiel. Recordaba los días en que era joven y fue infiel en la tierra de Egipto.

sw.L: Hata hivyo akaongeza ukahaba wake, akizikumbuka siku za ujana wake, alipofanya ukahaba katika nchi ya Misri.
sw.B: Hata hivyo alizidi kufanya ukahaba, akizikumbuka siku za ujana wake alipofanya ukahaba katika nchi ya Misri.
sw.R: Lakini akazidi kutokuwa mwaminifu. Alizikumbuka siku za ujana wake, alipokuwa si mwaminifu katika nchi ya Misri.

ko.L: 그러나 그 여자는 이집트 땅에서 음행하던 자기 젊은 날들을 기억하며 자기 음행을 더 많이 했다.
ko.B: 그런데도 그 여자는 이집트 땅에서 음행하던 젊은 시절을 떠올리며 점점 더 음행했다.
ko.R: 그런데도 오홀리바는 점점 더 신실하지 않게 되었다. 그 여자는 젊었을 때 이집트 땅에서 신실하지 않게 살던 날들을 떠올렸다.

decisions.choice: remembering Egypt: Judah's last hope placed in Egypt
decisions.reason: In its last years Judah turned to Egypt for help against Babylon. Zedekiah sent envoys to Egypt for horses and soldiers (17:15), and an Egyptian army briefly drew Babylon away from the siege (Jeremiah 37:5-7).

source.text: וַֽתַּעְגְּבָ֔ה עַ֖ל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּשַׂר־חֲמוֹרִים֙ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְזִרְמַ֥ת סוּסִ֖ים זִרְמָתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh [is the] flesh of donkeys, and whose emission [is the] emission of horses.

en.L: And she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh [is like] the flesh of donkeys, and whose emission [is like] the emission of horses.
en.B: She lusted after her lovers there, men with genitals like a donkey's and emissions like a stallion's.
en.R: She longed for her lovers there, men whose sexual organs were like a donkey's and whose semen was like a stallion's.

fr.L: Et elle a désiré ardemment leurs amants, dont la chair [est comme] la chair des ânes, et dont l’écoulement [est comme] l’écoulement des chevaux.
fr.B: Elle a brûlé de désir pour ses amants de là-bas, des hommes au sexe comme celui des ânes et à l’écoulement comme celui des étalons.
fr.R: Elle désirait ses amants de là-bas, des hommes dont le sexe était comme celui d’un âne et dont la semence était comme celle d’un étalon.

es.L: Y se apasionó por sus amantes, cuya carne [es como] carne de asnos, y cuyo flujo [es como] flujo de caballos.
es.B: Se apasionó por sus amantes de allí, hombres con genitales como los de un asno y eyaculación como la de un caballo.
es.R: Deseó a sus amantes de allí, hombres cuyos órganos sexuales eran como los de un asno y cuyo semen era como el de un caballo.

sw.L: Naye akawatamani wapenzi wao, ambao mwili wao [ni kama] mwili wa punda, na shahawa yao [ni kama] shahawa ya farasi.
sw.B: Aliwatamani wapenzi wake wa huko, wanaume wenye viungo vya uzazi kama vya punda na shahawa kama ya farasi dume.
sw.R: Aliwaonea shauku wapenzi wake wa huko, wanaume ambao viungo vyao vya uzazi vilikuwa kama vya punda, na shahawa yao kama ya farasi dume.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 그곳의 정부들에게 욕정을 품었으니, 그들의 살은 나귀의 살 [같고], 그들의 사정은 말의 사정 [같았다].
ko.B: 그 여자는 그곳의 애인들에게 욕정을 품었다. 그들은 나귀 같은 성기와 종마 같은 사정을 가진 남자들이었다.
ko.R: 오홀리바는 그곳의 애인들을 몹시 원했다. 그들은 성기가 나귀의 것과 같고, 정액이 종마의 것과 같은 남자들이었다.

decisions.choice: paramours: male lovers
decisions.reason: The word is the one usually used for a concubine, a secondary wife. Here it is used of the woman's male lovers, the Egyptians. The use is unusual, and its exact sense is not certain.

decisions.choice: flesh and emission like donkeys and horses: the Egyptians pictured as animals in their lust
decisions.reason: "Flesh" here means the male organ, as in Leviticus 15:2-3, and "emission" the flow of semen. The comparison is deliberately coarse. It shows how base Judah's desire for Egypt's power was, and the prophet's disgust at it. Jeremiah 5:8 uses horses in a similar way.

decisions.choice: Literal keeps "flesh" and "emission"; Balanced says "genitals" and "emission"; Readable says "sexual organs" and "semen"
alternatives: a euphemism such as "who were strong as horses"
decisions.reason: The register rule requires that the meaning be stated plainly without coarse words or added detail. Literal keeps the Hebrew's words, which the reader of Leviticus 15 will recognize. Balanced and Readable use the plain, sober names. This verse needs careful human review.

decisions.choice: carne, flujo (L); genitales, eyaculación (B); órganos sexuales, semen (R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the Hebrew's veiled words; B and R name what they mean plainly, in sober, not vulgar, Spanish.

decisions.choice: "mwili" and "shahawa" (L); "viungo vya uzazi" and "shahawa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew "flesh"; Balanced and Readable name the meaning in the standard, sober words for the body.

decisions.choice: 살 and 사정 (L); 성기 and 사정 (B); 성기 and 정액 (R)
decisions.reason: As the English register decision: Literal keeps "flesh", Balanced and Readable name what is meant in plain, sober words, neither softer nor coarser than the Hebrew.

source.text: וַֽתִּפְקְדִ֔י אֵ֖ת זִמַּ֣ת נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בַּעְשׂ֤וֹת מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ דַּדַּ֔יִךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁדֵ֥י נְעוּרָֽיִךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you longed for [the] lewdness of your youth, when [men] from Egypt handled your nipples for the sake of [the] breasts of your youth.

en.L: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when [men] from Egypt handled your nipples for the sake of your young breasts.
en.B: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when the Egyptians fondled your nipples and your young breasts.
en.R: You longed to do the shameful things you had done when you were young, when the Egyptians touched your young breasts.

fr.L: Ainsi tu as regretté l’infamie de ta jeunesse, quand [les gens] d’Égypte caressaient tes mamelons à cause de tes seins de jeune fille.
fr.B: Ainsi tu as regretté l’infamie de ta jeunesse, quand les Égyptiens caressaient tes mamelons et tes seins de jeune fille.
fr.R: Tu as eu envie de refaire les choses honteuses que tu faisais quand tu étais jeune, quand les Égyptiens touchaient tes seins de jeune fille.

es.B: Así añoraste la lascivia de tu juventud, cuando los egipcios acariciaban tus pezones y tus pechos jóvenes.
es.R: Deseabas volver a hacer las cosas vergonzosas que hacías cuando eras joven, cuando los egipcios te tocaban los pechos jóvenes.

sw.B: Hivyo uliutamani uasherati wa ujana wako, Wamisri walipozipapasa chuchu zako na matiti yako ya ujana.
sw.R: Ulitamani kufanya tena mambo ya aibu uliyoyafanya ulipokuwa msichana mdogo, Wamisri walipoyagusa matiti yako ya ujana.

ko.L: 그리하여 너는 네 젊은 시절의 음란함을 그리워했다. 그때 이집트에서 [남자들이] 네 젊은 가슴 때문에 네 젖꼭지를 만졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 너는 젊은 시절의 음란한 짓을 그리워했다. 그때 이집트 사람들이 네 젖꼭지와 젊은 가슴을 주물렀다.
ko.R: 너는 젊었을 때 하던 부끄러운 짓을 다시 하고 싶어 했다. 그때 이집트 사람들이 네 젊은 가슴을 만졌다.

decisions.choice: you longed: God now speaks to Oholibah directly
decisions.reason: From here to the end of verse 35 the LORD speaks to Jerusalem as "you". The shift brings the story home to the hearers.

decisions.choice: lewdness: shameful, depraved conduct, especially sexual
decisions.reason: The word is used for sexual sins in the law (Leviticus 18:17) and throughout chapters 16 and 23.

decisions.choice: lewdness (L, B); shameful things, shameful ways (R)
decisions.reason: The word is "lewdness" at Literal and Balanced and is said in plainer words at Readable, here and through the chapter. The sexual picture keeps the register of verse 3.

decisions.choice: *zimmah* "infamie" (L, B); "choses honteuses", "conduite honteuse" (R), for the whole chapter
decisions.reason: French keeps one word for *zimmah* at L and B, as the English "lewdness"; Readable follows the English "shameful things, shameful ways". "Débauche" is kept for the lust of 23:8.

decisions.choice: lascivia (L, B); cosas vergonzosas, conducta vergonzosa (R)
decisions.reason: Zimmah keeps one word at each level through these chapters; Oholibah is now addressed directly with feminine 'tú'.

decisions.choice: "uasherati" (L, B); "mambo ya aibu", "njia za aibu" (R) for zimmah
decisions.reason: "Uasherati" is the ordinary word for sexual immorality; "ufisadi" now usually means corruption. Readable follows the English "shameful things". Used through this chapter.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן אָהֳלִיבָ֗ה כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנְנִ֨י מֵעִ֤יר אֶת־מְאַהֲבַ֨יִךְ֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶ֑ם וַהֲבֵאתִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִךְ מִסָּבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Behold, I [am] stirring up your lovers against you, from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them against you from every side:

en.L: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: See, I am stirring up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul turned in disgust, and I will bring them on you from all around:
en.B: Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to stir up your lovers against you, the ones you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them upon you from all sides:
en.R: So, Oholibah, this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am going to turn your lovers against you, the ones you turned away from in disgust. I will bring them against you from every side.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, Oholiba, ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je soulève contre toi tes amants, ceux dont ton âme s’est détachée avec dégoût, et je les amènerai contre toi de tous côtés :
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, Oholiba, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais soulever contre toi tes amants, ceux dont tu t’es détournée avec dégoût, et je les ferai venir contre toi de tous côtés :
fr.R: Alors, Oholiba, voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais retourner tes amants contre toi, ceux dont tu t’es détournée avec dégoût. Je les ferai venir contre toi de tous côtés.

es.L: Por tanto, Aholibá, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Mira, yo despierto contra ti a tus amantes, de los cuales tu alma se apartó con asco, y los traeré contra ti de todas partes:
es.B: Por eso, Aholibá, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a levantar contra ti a tus amantes, aquellos de los que te apartaste con asco, y los traeré contra ti por todos lados:
es.R: Así que, Aholibá, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Voy a poner a tus amantes en contra de ti, aquellos de los que te apartaste con asco. Los traeré contra ti por todos lados.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, Oholiba, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninawaamsha wapenzi wako juu yako, wale ambao nafsi yako iliwachukia ukajitenga nao, nami nitawaleta juu yako kutoka pande zote:
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, Oholiba, hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kuwachochea wapenzi wako dhidi yako, wale uliowachukia ukajitenga nao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaleta juu yako kutoka pande zote:
sw.R: Basi, Oholiba, hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitawageuza wapenzi wako wawe adui zako, wale uliowachukia ukajitenga nao. Nitawaleta wakushambulie kutoka kila upande.

ko.L: 그러므로 오홀리바야, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내가 네 애인들, 곧 네 마음이 싫증 나 떠난 자들을 일으켜 너를 치게 하고, 그들을 사방에서 너에게로 데려오겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 오홀리바야, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 보아라, 네가 역겨워 돌아섰던 네 애인들을 내가 일으켜 너를 치게 하겠다. 내가 그들을 사방에서 너에게로 데려오겠다.
ko.R: 그러니 오홀리바야, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 네 애인들, 곧 네가 역겨워 돌아섰던 그들이 너를 공격하게 하겠다. 나는 그들을 사방에서 너에게로 데려오겠다.

decisions.choice: I am stirring up your lovers against you: the Babylonians, whom Judah courted and then rejected
decisions.reason: Babylon, which Judah first sought and then rebelled against (verses 16-17), will come back as the LORD's instrument of judgment, as Assyria did against Samaria (verse 9).

decisions.choice: I am about to stir up (B); I am going to turn ... against you (R)
decisions.reason: "See" with a participle is put as an action about to happen at Balanced and Readable. The colon at Literal and Balanced leads into the list of verse 23.

source.text: בְּנֵ֧י בָבֶ֣ל וְכָל־כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים פְּק֤וֹד וְשׁ֨וֹעַ֙ וְק֔וֹעַ כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתָ֑ם בַּח֨וּרֵי חֶ֜מֶד פַּח֤וֹת וּסְגָנִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם שָֽׁלִשִׁים֙ וּקְרוּאִ֔ים רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] sons of Babylon and all [the] Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all [the] sons of Assyria with them, young men of desire, governors and commanders all of them, officers and called ones, riding horses all of them.

en.L: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the sons of Assyria with them, desirable young men, governors and commanders all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
en.B: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa and Koa, together with all the Assyrians, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, all mounted on horses.
en.R: the Babylonians and all the peoples of Babylonia, the people of Pekod, Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them. They are handsome young men, governors and commanders, officers and famous men, all riding on horses.

fr.L: les fils de Babylone et tous les Chaldéens, Peqod et Shoa et Qoa, tous les fils d’Assour avec eux, jeunes hommes désirables, gouverneurs et commandants, eux tous, officiers et hommes renommés, tous montés sur des chevaux.
fr.B: les Babyloniens et tous les Chaldéens, Peqod, Shoa et Qoa, et avec eux tous les Assyriens, de beaux jeunes gens, tous gouverneurs et commandants, officiers et hommes renommés, tous montés sur des chevaux.
fr.R: les Babyloniens et tous les peuples de Babylonie, les gens de Peqod, de Shoa et de Qoa, et tous les Assyriens avec eux. Ce sont de beaux jeunes gens, des gouverneurs et des commandants, des officiers et des hommes célèbres, qui montent tous à cheval.

es.L: los hijos de Babilonia y todos los caldeos, Pecod y Soa y Coa, todos los hijos de Asiria con ellos, jóvenes deseables, gobernadores y comandantes todos ellos, oficiales y hombres de renombre, todos ellos montados a caballo.
es.B: los babilonios y todos los caldeos, Pecod, Soa y Coa, junto con todos los asirios, jóvenes apuestos, todos ellos gobernadores y comandantes, oficiales y hombres de renombre, todos montados a caballo.
es.R: Vendrán los babilonios y todos los pueblos de Babilonia, la gente de Pecod, Soa y Coa, y todos los asirios con ellos. Son jóvenes apuestos, gobernadores y comandantes, oficiales y hombres famosos, todos montados a caballo.

sw.L: wana wa Babeli na Wakaldayo wote, Pekodi na Shoa na Koa, wana wote wa Ashuru pamoja nao, vijana wa kutamanika, wote maliwali na majemadari, maafisa na watu mashuhuri, wote wakipanda farasi.
sw.B: Wababeli na Wakaldayo wote, Pekodi, Shoa na Koa, pamoja na Waashuru wote, vijana wazuri wa sura, wote maliwali na majemadari, maafisa na watu mashuhuri, wote wapanda farasi.
sw.R: Wababeli na watu wote wa Babeli, watu wa Pekodi, Shoa na Koa, na Waashuru wote pamoja nao. Ni vijana wazuri wa sura, maliwali na majemadari, maafisa na watu maarufu, wote wakipanda farasi.

ko.L: 바빌론 자손과 모든 갈대아 사람들, 브곳과 소아와 고아, 그리고 그들과 함께 모든 앗시리아 자손, 탐스러운 젊은이들, 모두 총독들과 지휘관들, 장교들과 이름난 자들, 모두 말을 탄 자들이다.
ko.B: 바빌론 사람들과 모든 갈대아 사람들, 브곳과 소아와 고아 사람들, 그리고 그들과 함께 모든 앗시리아 사람들이다. 그들은 잘생긴 젊은이들로서 모두 총독들과 지휘관들이며, 장교들과 이름난 자들이고, 모두 말을 탄 자들이다.
ko.R: 바빌론 사람들과 바빌로니아의 모든 민족, 브곳과 소아와 고아 사람들, 그리고 그들과 함께 있는 모든 앗시리아 사람들이다. 그들은 잘생긴 젊은이들이며, 총독들과 지휘관들, 장교들과 유명한 사람들로서 모두 말을 타고 있다.

decisions.choice: Pekod, Shoa and Koa: peoples of the Babylonian empire
decisions.reason: Pekod is known from Babylonian and Assyrian records as an Aramean tribe in eastern Babylonia (compare Jeremiah 50:21). Shoa and Koa are usually taken as peoples east of the Tigris known from the same records. The names also sound like Hebrew words for "punish" and "cry for help", and the prophet may be playing on them.

decisions.choice: the Assyrians with them: soldiers from the former Assyrian lands now under Babylon
decisions.reason: Assyria had fallen to Babylon by 609 BC. The "sons of Assyria" here are most likely troops from its former lands in Nebuchadnezzar's army, or the name is used for all the peoples of Mesopotamia.

decisions.choice: men of renown: men summoned, or famous men
decisions.reason: The word means "called" and can mean those who are summoned to council or those who are well known (Numbers 1:16).

decisions.choice: the peoples of Babylonia
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans are "Babylonians" at Readable; since "Babylonians" comes first in the list, Readable says "the peoples of Babylonia" for the second name.

decisions.choice: "Peqod", "Shoa", "Qoa"
decisions.reason: "Peqod" as French Jeremiah 50:21; "Qoa" with the same q for the Hebrew qoph.

decisions.choice: Pecod, Soa y Coa
decisions.reason: The names are written as Spanish writes Hebrew names (c for k, s for sh), as Spanish Jeremiah 50:21 Pecod.

decisions.choice: 브곳, 소아, 고아
decisions.reason: 브곳 is the published form (Jer 50:21); 소아 and 고아 are spelled the same way from the Hebrew.

source.text: וּבָ֣אוּ עָלַ֡יִךְ הֹ֠צֶן רֶ֤כֶב וְגַלְגַּל֙ וּבִקְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֔ים צִנָּ֤ה וּמָגֵן֙ וְקוֹבַ֔ע יָשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלַ֖יִךְ סָבִ֑יב וְנָתַתִּ֤י לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּשְׁפָט֖וּךְ בְּמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will come against you with weapons, chariot and wheel, and with an assembly of peoples; buckler and shield and helmet they will set against you all around; and I will set before them judgment, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

en.L: And they will come against you with weapons, chariot and wheel, and with a company of peoples; buckler and shield and helmet they will set against you all around; and I will set judgment before them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
en.B: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and a horde of peoples. They will take up positions against you on every side with large shields, small shields and helmets. I will hand over judgment to them, and they will judge you by their own standards.
en.R: They will attack you with weapons, chariots and wagons and a great army from many nations. They will surround you with their shields and helmets. I will let them judge you, and they will punish you in their own way.

fr.L: Et ils viendront contre toi avec des armes, char et roue, et avec une assemblée de peuples ; bouclier et écu et casque, ils [les] placeront contre toi tout autour ; et je remettrai devant eux le jugement, et ils te jugeront selon leurs jugements.
fr.B: Ils viendront contre toi avec des armes, des chars, des chariots et une foule de peuples. Ils prendront position contre toi de tous côtés, avec grands et petits boucliers et casques. Je leur confierai le jugement, et ils te jugeront selon leurs propres lois.
fr.R: Ils t’attaqueront avec des armes, des chars, des chariots et une grande armée venue de nombreux peuples. Ils t’entoureront avec leurs boucliers et leurs casques. Je les laisserai te juger, et ils te puniront à leur manière.

es.L: Y vendrán contra ti con armas, carros y ruedas, y con multitud de pueblos; escudo y broquel y casco pondrán contra ti alrededor; y pondré delante de ellos el juicio, y te juzgarán según sus juicios.
es.B: Vendrán contra ti con armas, carros y carretas y una multitud de pueblos. Se apostarán contra ti por todos lados con escudos grandes, escudos pequeños y cascos. Les entregaré el juicio, y te juzgarán según sus propias leyes.
es.R: Te atacarán con armas, carros y carretas y con un gran ejército de muchas naciones. Te rodearán con sus escudos y sus cascos. Dejaré que ellos te juzguen, y te castigarán a su manera.

sw.L: Nao watakuja juu yako wakiwa na silaha, gari la vita na gurudumu, na kusanyiko la mataifa; ngao ndogo na ngao kubwa na kofia za chuma wataziweka dhidi yako pande zote; nami nitaweka hukumu mbele yao, nao watakuhukumu kwa hukumu zao.
sw.B: Watakuja dhidi yako wakiwa na silaha, magari ya vita na magari ya mizigo, na kundi kubwa la mataifa. Watajipanga dhidi yako pande zote wakiwa na ngao kubwa, ngao ndogo na kofia za chuma. Nitawapa wao kazi ya kukuhukumu, nao watakuhukumu kwa sheria zao wenyewe.
sw.R: Watakushambulia kwa silaha, magari ya vita na magari ya mizigo, na jeshi kubwa kutoka mataifa mengi. Watakuzunguka wakiwa na ngao zao na kofia za chuma. Nitawaacha wakuhukumu, nao watakuadhibu kwa njia yao wenyewe.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 무기와 병거와 바퀴와 민족들의 무리를 이끌고 너를 치러 올 것이다. 그들은 큰 방패와 작은 방패와 투구로 사방에서 너를 대적하여 진을 칠 것이다. 그리고 내가 그들 앞에 심판을 맡기겠으니, 그들이 자기들의 법도대로 너를 심판할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 무기와 병거와 수레와 여러 민족의 무리를 이끌고 너를 치러 올 것이다. 그들은 큰 방패와 작은 방패를 들고 투구를 쓰고 사방에서 너를 에워쌀 것이다. 내가 심판을 그들에게 맡기겠으니, 그들은 자기들의 법대로 너를 심판할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 무기와 병거와 수레를 가지고, 여러 나라에서 온 큰 군대를 이끌고 너를 공격할 것이다. 그들은 방패를 들고 투구를 쓰고 너를 에워쌀 것이다. 나는 그들이 너를 심판하게 하겠다. 그들은 자기들 방식대로 너를 벌할 것이다.

decisions.choice: weapons: an uncertain word
alternatives: a word for a large army or for chariots
decisions.reason: The word is found only here, and its meaning is guessed. The Greek reads "from the north", the direction from which Babylon's armies came (26:7; Jeremiah 1:14).

decisions.choice: they will judge you according to their judgments: by their own harsh laws and customs
decisions.reason: God hands the case over to the nations, who will punish Jerusalem as they punish rebels and unfaithful wives. The same is said in 16:38-41.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֨י קִנְאָתִ֜י בָּ֗ךְ וְעָשׂ֤וּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּחֵמָ֔ה אַפֵּ֤ךְ וְאָזְנַ֨יִךְ֙ יָסִ֔ירוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפּ֑וֹל הֵ֗מָּה בָּנַ֤יִךְ וּבְנוֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ תֵּאָכֵ֥ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in wrath; your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant by the sword will fall; they your sons and your daughters will take, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.

en.L: And I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealousy against you, and in wrath they will deal with you; your nose and your ears they will cut off, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword; your sons and your daughters they will take, and what is left of you will be consumed by fire.
en.B: I will direct {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealous anger against you, and they will treat you with wrath. They will cut off your nose and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and what is left of you will be consumed by fire.
en.R: I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in anger. They will cut off your nose and your ears. Those of you who are left will be killed with the sword. They will take your sons and daughters away. Whatever is left of you will be burned up.

fr.L: Et je dirigerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} jalousie contre toi, et ils agiront avec toi avec fureur ; ton nez et tes oreilles, ils les enlèveront, et ceux qui resteront de toi tomberont par l’épée ; tes fils et tes filles, ils les prendront, et ce qui restera de toi sera dévoré par le feu.
fr.B: Je tournerai contre toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère jalouse, et ils te traiteront avec fureur. Ils te couperont le nez et les oreilles, et ceux des tiens qui resteront tomberont par l’épée. Ils prendront tes fils et tes filles, et ce qui restera de toi sera dévoré par le feu.
fr.R: Je tournerai contre toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère jalouse, et ils te traiteront avec colère. Ils te couperont le nez et les oreilles. Ceux des tiens qui resteront seront tués par l’épée. Ils emmèneront tes fils et tes filles. Tout ce qui restera de toi sera brûlé.

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} celos contra ti, y te tratarán con furor; tu nariz y tus orejas cortarán, y lo que quede de ti caerá a espada; ellos tomarán a tus hijos y a tus hijas, y lo que quede de ti será consumido por el fuego.
es.B: Dirigiré contra ti {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} celos airados, y te tratarán con furor. Te cortarán la nariz y las orejas, y los que queden de ti caerán a espada. Se llevarán a tus hijos y a tus hijas, y lo que quede de ti será consumido por el fuego.
es.R: Volveré contra ti {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} celos llenos de enojo, y te tratarán con enojo. Te cortarán la nariz y las orejas. Los que queden de ti morirán a espada. Se llevarán a tus hijos y a tus hijas. Lo que quede de ti será quemado.

sw.L: Nami nitauweka wivu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako, nao watakutendea kwa ghadhabu; pua yako na masikio yako wataviondoa, na waliobaki kwako wataanguka kwa upanga; wana wako na binti zako watawachukua, na kilichobaki kwako kitateketezwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Nitaielekeza hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya wivu dhidi yako, nao watakutendea kwa ghadhabu. Watakata pua yako na masikio yako, na wale wako waliobaki wataanguka kwa upanga. Watawachukua wana wako na binti zako, na kitakachobaki kwako kitateketezwa kwa moto.
sw.R: Nitaigeuza hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya wivu dhidi yako, nao watakutendea kwa hasira. Watakata pua yako na masikio yako. Wale wako watakaobaki watauawa kwa upanga. Watawachukua wana wako na binti zako. Chochote kitakachobaki kwako kitateketezwa kwa moto.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 질투를 너에게 쏟겠으니, 그들이 진노로 너를 다룰 것이다. 그들이 네 코와 네 귀를 잘라 낼 것이고, 너의 남은 자들은 칼에 쓰러질 것이다. 그들이 네 아들들과 네 딸들을 데려갈 것이고, 너의 남은 것은 불에 삼켜질 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 질투하는 분노를 너에게 돌리겠으니, 그들이 진노하며 너를 다룰 것이다. 그들은 네 코와 귀를 잘라 낼 것이고, 네 가운데 남은 자들은 칼에 쓰러질 것이다. 그들은 네 아들딸들을 데려갈 것이고, 너에게 남은 것은 불에 타 버릴 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 질투하는 내 분노를 너에게 돌리겠다. 그들은 화가 나서 너를 다룰 것이다. 그들은 네 코와 귀를 잘라 낼 것이다. 네 백성 가운데 살아남은 사람들은 칼에 맞아 죽을 것이다. 그들은 네 아들딸들을 끌고 갈 것이다. 너에게 남은 것은 모두 불에 타 버릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: my jealousy: God's anger at the betrayal of an exclusive covenant
decisions.reason: God's jealousy is his rightful claim to his people's sole loyalty, like a husband's claim on a wife (Exodus 20:5; 34:14). Ezekiel uses the word for the same picture in 16:38 and 42.

decisions.choice: cutting off the nose and ears: a known punishment in the ancient Near East
decisions.reason: Laws and records from Assyria and Egypt mention cutting off the nose or ears as a punishment, including for adultery, and as a treatment of captives. Here it is part of the picture of a city mutilated and shamed by its conquerors.

decisions.choice: your remnant: those who survive, and what is left of the city
decisions.reason: The word means "what comes after" or "what remains". It refers first to the people who survive and then to everything that is left, which will be burned (2 Kings 25:9).

source.text: וְהִפְשִׁיט֖וּךְ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י תִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry.

en.L: And they will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry.
en.B: They will strip off your clothes and take away your fine jewelry.
en.R: They will strip off your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry.

fr.L: Et ils te dépouilleront de tes vêtements et ils prendront tes bijoux de parure.
fr.B: Ils t’arracheront tes vêtements et emporteront tes beaux bijoux.
fr.R: Ils t’enlèveront tes vêtements et prendront tes beaux bijoux.

es.L: Y te despojarán de tus vestidos y tomarán tus hermosas joyas.
es.B: Te quitarán la ropa y se llevarán tus finas joyas.
es.R: Te quitarán la ropa y se llevarán tus hermosas joyas.

sw.L: Nao watakuvua nguo zako na kuchukua vito vyako vya uzuri.
sw.B: Watakuvua nguo zako na kuchukua vito vyako vya thamani.
sw.R: Watakuvua nguo zako na kuchukua vito vyako vizuri.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 네 옷을 벗기고 네 아름다운 장신구들을 빼앗을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 네 옷을 벗기고 네 고운 장신구들을 빼앗아 갈 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 네 옷을 벗기고 네 아름다운 장신구들을 가져갈 것이다.

decisions.choice: stripped and robbed: the punishment of 16:39
decisions.reason: In 16:39 Jerusalem's lovers strip her of her clothes and take her jewels. In the history, the Babylonians took the treasures of the temple and the palace (2 Kings 24:13; 25:13-17).

source.text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י זִמָּתֵךְ֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וְאֶת־זְנוּתֵ֖ךְ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־תִשְׂאִ֤י עֵינַ֨יִךְ֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־עֽוֹד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will put an end to your lewdness from you, and your prostitution from [the] land of Egypt, and you will not lift up your eyes to them, and Egypt you will not remember any more.

en.L: And I will put an end to your lewdness and your prostitution from the land of Egypt, and you will not lift up your eyes to them, and Egypt you will not remember any more.
en.B: So I will put an end to your lewdness and to the prostitution you began in the land of Egypt. You will not look to the Egyptians with longing or remember Egypt any more.
en.R: I will put an end to your shameful ways and to the unfaithfulness you began in Egypt. You will not long for the Egyptians or think about Egypt any more.

fr.L: Et je ferai cesser chez toi ton infamie et ta prostitution [venue] du pays d’Égypte, et tu ne lèveras plus les yeux vers eux, et de l’Égypte tu ne te souviendras plus.
fr.B: Ainsi je mettrai fin à ton infamie et à la prostitution que tu as commencée au pays d’Égypte. Tu ne tourneras plus tes regards vers les Égyptiens, et tu ne te souviendras plus de l’Égypte.
fr.R: Je mettrai fin à ta conduite honteuse et à l’infidélité que tu as commencée en Égypte. Tu ne désireras plus les Égyptiens et tu ne penseras plus à l’Égypte.

es.L: Y pondré fin a tu lascivia y a tu prostitución de la tierra de Egipto, y no alzarás tus ojos hacia ellos, ni te acordarás más de Egipto.
es.B: Así pondré fin a tu lascivia y a la prostitución que comenzaste en la tierra de Egipto. Ya no mirarás con deseo a los egipcios ni te acordarás más de Egipto.
es.R: Pondré fin a tu conducta vergonzosa y a la infidelidad que comenzaste en Egipto. Ya no desearás a los egipcios ni pensarás más en Egipto.

sw.L: Nami nitaukomesha uasherati wako kwako, na ukahaba wako wa tangu nchi ya Misri, wala hutainua macho yako kuwaelekea, wala hutaikumbuka Misri tena.
sw.B: Hivyo nitaukomesha uasherati wako na ukahaba ulioanza katika nchi ya Misri. Hutawatazama Wamisri kwa shauku tena wala kuikumbuka Misri tena.
sw.R: Nitazikomesha njia zako za aibu na kutokuwa mwaminifu kwako ulikoanza Misri. Hutawaonea shauku Wamisri tena wala kuifikiria Misri tena.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너에게서 네 음란함과 이집트 땅에서부터 해 온 네 음행을 그치게 하겠다. 너는 그들에게 네 눈을 들지 않을 것이고, 이집트를 다시는 기억하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 내가 네 음란한 짓과 이집트 땅에서 시작한 네 음행을 끝내겠다. 너는 다시는 이집트 사람들을 그리워하며 바라보지 않을 것이고, 이집트를 다시는 떠올리지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 네 부끄러운 짓과 이집트에서 시작한 신실하지 못한 짓을 끝내겠다. 너는 다시는 이집트 사람들을 그리워하지 않을 것이고, 이집트를 생각하지도 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: lift up your eyes to them: look to them with desire or for help
decisions.reason: The same idiom is used of idols in 18:6 and 33:25.

decisions.choice: I will put an end to your lewdness: the judgment ends the long history
decisions.reason: The punishment will at last break the habit that began in Egypt (verse 3).

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ נֹֽתְנָ֔ךְ בְּיַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את בְּיַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Behold, I [am] giving you into [the] hand of [those] whom you hate, into [the] hand of [those] from whom your soul turned away.

en.L: For thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: See, I am giving you into the hand of those whom you hate, into the hand of those from whom your soul turned in disgust.
en.B: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to hand you over to those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am going to hand you over to the people you hate, the people you turned away from in disgust.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je te livre entre les mains de ceux que tu hais, entre les mains de ceux dont ton âme s’est détachée avec dégoût.
fr.B: Car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais te livrer à ceux que tu détestes, à ceux dont tu t’es détournée avec dégoût.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais te livrer aux gens que tu détestes, aux gens dont tu t’es détournée avec dégoût.

es.L: Porque así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Mira, yo te entrego en mano de los que aborreces, en mano de aquellos de quienes tu alma se apartó con asco.
es.B: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a entregarte en manos de los que odias, de aquellos de los que te apartaste con asco.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Voy a entregarte a la gente que odias, a la gente de la que te apartaste con asco.

sw.L: Kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninakutia mkononi mwa wale unaowachukia, mkononi mwa wale ambao nafsi yako iliwachukia ukajitenga nao.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kukutia mikononi mwa wale unaowachukia, wale uliowachukia ukajitenga nao.
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitakutia mikononi mwa watu unaowachukia, watu uliowachukia ukajitenga nao.

ko.L: 참으로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내가 너를 네가 미워하는 자들의 손에, 네 마음이 싫증 나 떠난 자들의 손에 넘겨주겠다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 너를 네가 미워하는 자들, 네가 역겨워 돌아섰던 자들에게 넘겨주려 한다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 너를 네가 미워하는 사람들, 네가 역겨워 돌아섰던 사람들에게 넘겨주겠다.

decisions.choice: into the hand of those you hate: the former lovers
decisions.reason: Love turned to hatred (verses 17-18), and Jerusalem will be given to those she came to hate. The same is said in 16:37.

source.text: וְעָשׂ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּשִׂנְאָ֗ה וְלָקְחוּ֙ כָּל־יְגִיעֵ֔ךְ וַעֲזָב֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֑ה וְנִגְלָה֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת זְנוּנַ֔יִךְ וְזִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will deal with you in hatred and take all your labor and leave you naked and bare; and will be uncovered [the] nakedness of your prostitutions, and your lewdness and your prostitutions.

en.L: And they will deal with you in hatred, and they will take all [the fruit of] your labor and leave you naked and bare; and the nakedness of your prostitution will be laid bare, your lewdness and your prostitution.
en.B: They will deal with you in hatred, take away everything you have worked for and leave you naked and bare. The shame of your prostitution will be exposed, your lewdness and your prostitution.
en.R: They will treat you with hatred. They will take away everything you worked for and leave you completely naked. Everyone will see your shame, the shame of your unfaithfulness and your shameful ways.

fr.L: Et ils agiront avec toi avec haine, et ils prendront tout [le fruit de] ton travail, et ils te laisseront nue et dévêtue ; et la nudité de tes prostitutions sera découverte, ton infamie et tes prostitutions.
fr.B: Ils te traiteront avec haine, ils te prendront tout ce que tu as gagné par ton travail et te laisseront nue et dépouillée. La honte de ta prostitution sera exposée, ton infamie et ta prostitution.
fr.R: Ils te traiteront avec haine. Ils te prendront tout ce que tu as gagné en travaillant et te laisseront complètement nue. Tout le monde verra ta honte, la honte de ton infidélité et de ta conduite honteuse.

es.L: Y te tratarán con odio, y tomarán todo [el fruto de] tu trabajo y te dejarán desnuda y descubierta; y quedará al descubierto la desnudez de tus prostituciones, tu lascivia y tus prostituciones.
es.B: Te tratarán con odio, se llevarán todo aquello por lo que trabajaste y te dejarán desnuda y descubierta. Quedará al descubierto la vergüenza de tu prostitución, tu lascivia y tu prostitución.
es.R: Te tratarán con odio. Se llevarán todo aquello por lo que trabajaste y te dejarán completamente desnuda. Todos verán tu vergüenza, la vergüenza de tu infidelidad y de tu conducta vergonzosa.

sw.L: Nao watakutendea kwa chuki, na kuchukua [matunda ya] kazi yako yote, na kukuacha uchi na bila nguo; na uchi wa ukahaba wako utafunuliwa, uasherati wako na ukahaba wako.
sw.B: Watakutendea kwa chuki, watachukua kila kitu ulichofanyia kazi na kukuacha uchi kabisa. Aibu ya ukahaba wako itafunuliwa, uasherati wako na ukahaba wako.
sw.R: Watakutendea kwa chuki. Watachukua kila kitu ulichofanyia kazi na kukuacha uchi kabisa. Kila mtu ataiona aibu yako, aibu ya kutokuwa mwaminifu kwako na ya njia zako za aibu.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 미움으로 너를 다루고, 네 수고한 모든 것을 빼앗고, 너를 벌거벗은 알몸으로 버려둘 것이다. 그러면 네 음행의 벗은 몸, 곧 네 음란함과 네 음행이 드러날 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 미움으로 너를 다루고, 네가 수고하여 얻은 모든 것을 빼앗고, 너를 벌거벗은 알몸으로 버려둘 것이다. 네 음행의 수치, 곧 네 음란한 짓과 음행이 드러날 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 너를 미워하며 함부로 대할 것이다. 그들은 네가 일해서 얻은 모든 것을 빼앗고 너를 완전히 벌거벗겨 둘 것이다. 모든 사람이 네 수치, 곧 네가 신실하지 않았던 일과 네 부끄러운 짓을 보게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: take all your labor: take everything you have worked for
decisions.reason: "Labor" stands for what labor produces, all of a person's goods.

decisions.choice: naked and bare: as in 16:7 and 16:39
decisions.reason: Jerusalem was "naked and bare" when the LORD found her (16:7, 22), and she will be left so again (16:39).

source.text: עָשֹׂ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־נִטְמֵ֖את בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [One will] do these to you because you prostituted yourself after nations, because you defiled yourself with their idols.

en.L: These [things will be] done to you, because you prostituted yourself after the nations, because you defiled yourself with their filthy idols.
en.B: This will be done to you because you prostituted yourself with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
en.R: This will happen to you because you went after the nations and were unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, like a woman with many lovers. You made yourself unclean with their idols.

fr.L: Ces [choses] te [seront] faites parce que tu t’es prostituée après les nations, parce que tu t’es souillée avec leurs idoles immondes.
fr.B: Cela te sera fait parce que tu t’es prostituée avec les nations et que tu t’es souillée avec leurs idoles.
fr.R: Cela t’arrivera parce que tu as couru après les nations et que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as été infidèle, comme une femme qui a beaucoup d’amants. Tu t’es rendue impure avec leurs idoles.

es.L: Estas [cosas] te [serán] hechas, porque te prostituiste tras las naciones, porque te contaminaste con sus ídolos inmundos.
es.B: Esto te sucederá porque te prostituiste con las naciones y te contaminaste con sus ídolos.
es.R: Esto te sucederá porque fuiste tras las naciones y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fuiste infiel, como una mujer con muchos amantes. Te hiciste impura con sus ídolos.

sw.L: Mambo haya [yatatendwa] kwako, kwa sababu ulifanya ukahaba ukiyafuata mataifa, kwa sababu ulijitia unajisi kwa sanamu zao chafu.
sw.B: Haya yatafanywa kwako kwa sababu ulifanya ukahaba na mataifa na kujitia unajisi kwa sanamu zao.
sw.R: Haya yatakupata kwa sababu uliyafuata mataifa na hukuwa mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, kama mke mwenye wapenzi wengi. Ulijifanya najisi kwa sanamu zao.

ko.L: 이런 일들이 너에게 행해질 것이니, 네가 민족들을 따라 음행했고, 그들의 더러운 우상들로 너를 더럽혔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이런 일이 너에게 닥칠 것이다. 네가 민족들과 음행했고, 그들의 우상들로 너를 더럽혔기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이런 일이 너에게 일어날 것이다. 네가 다른 민족들을 따라가며 애인을 여럿 둔 여자처럼 나에게 신실하지 않았기 때문이다. 너는 그들의 우상들로 너 자신을 더럽혔다.

decisions.choice: after the nations, with their idols: the picture explained
decisions.reason: Here the meaning of the allegory is stated: the "lovers" are the nations, and the unfaithfulness is going after them and their idols.
