decisions.choice: were unfaithful to me, like a woman with many lovers
decisions.reason: The verb follows the wording set for Ezekiel: "prostitute oneself" at Literal and Balanced, and "be unfaithful, like a woman with many lovers" at Readable (see 16:1). The noun follows it: "prostitution" (L, B), "unfaithfulness" (R).

source.text: בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֖ךְ הָלָ֑כְתְּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י כוֹסָ֖הּ בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: In [the] way of your sister you have walked, and I will give her cup into your hand.

en.L: In the way of your sister you have walked, and I will give her cup into your hand.
en.B: You have walked in your sister's way, so I will put her cup into your hand.
en.R: You have done what your sister did. So I will make you drink from the same cup of punishment that she drank.

fr.L: Dans le chemin de ta sœur tu as marché, et je mettrai sa coupe dans ta main.
fr.B: Tu as suivi le chemin de ta sœur ; c’est pourquoi je mettrai sa coupe dans ta main.
fr.R: Tu as fait ce que ta sœur a fait. C’est pourquoi je te ferai boire à la même coupe de punition qu’elle.

es.L: En el camino de tu hermana anduviste, y pondré su copa en tu mano.
es.B: Has seguido el camino de tu hermana; por eso pondré su copa en tu mano.
es.R: Has hecho lo mismo que hizo tu hermana. Por eso te haré beber de la misma copa de castigo que ella bebió.

sw.L: Katika njia ya dada yako umekwenda, nami nitakitia kikombe chake mkononi mwako.
sw.B: Umeifuata njia ya dada yako, kwa hiyo nitakitia kikombe chake mkononi mwako.
sw.R: Umefanya kama dada yako alivyofanya. Kwa hiyo nitakunywesha kutoka kikombe kile kile cha adhabu alichokinywa yeye.

ko.L: 네가 네 언니의 길로 걸었으니, 내가 그 여자의 잔을 네 손에 주겠다.
ko.B: 네가 네 언니의 길을 걸었으니, 내가 그 여자의 잔을 네 손에 쥐여 주겠다.
ko.R: 너는 네 언니가 한 대로 했다. 그래서 나는 네 언니가 마신 것과 똑같은 벌의 잔을 너에게도 마시게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: her cup: the cup of God's wrath
decisions.reason: The prophets picture God's judgment as a cup that nations are made to drink until they stagger (Jeremiah 25:15-29; Isaiah 51:17; Psalm 75:9). Verses 32-34 describe the cup.

decisions.choice: cup of punishment
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup stands for (m1).

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה כּ֤וֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ֙ תִּשְׁתִּ֔י הָעֲמֻקָּ֖ה וְהָרְחָבָ֑ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לִצְחֹ֛ק וּלְלַ֖עַג מִרְבָּ֥ה לְהָכִֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: [The] cup of your sister you will drink, the deep and the wide; it will be for laughter and for derision, holding much.

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: The cup of your sister you will drink, deep and wide; it will be for laughter and for scorn, so much it holds.
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Your sister's cup you will drink, deep and wide. It will bring you scorn and mockery, for it holds so much.
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: You will drink from your sister's cup, a large and deep cup that holds a lot. People will laugh at you and make fun of you.

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : La coupe de ta sœur, tu la boiras, profonde et large ; elle sera [un objet] de rire et de moquerie, tant elle contient.
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Tu boiras la coupe de ta sœur, profonde et large. Elle t’attirera le mépris et la moquerie, car elle contient beaucoup.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Tu boiras à la coupe de ta sœur, une coupe grande et profonde, qui contient beaucoup. Les gens riront de toi et se moqueront de toi.

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: La copa de tu hermana beberás, honda y ancha; servirá de risa y de escarnio, tanto es lo que contiene.
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Beberás la copa de tu hermana, honda y ancha. Te traerá burla y escarnio, porque es mucho lo que contiene.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Beberás de la copa de tu hermana, una copa grande y honda en la que cabe mucho. La gente se reirá de ti y se burlará de ti.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kikombe cha dada yako utakinywa, kirefu na kipana; kitakuwa cha kuchekwa na cha kudharauliwa, kwa kuwa kinachukua mengi.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Utakinywa kikombe cha dada yako, kirefu na kipana. Kitakuletea dharau na dhihaka, kwa maana kinachukua mengi.
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Utakunywa kutoka kikombe cha dada yako, kikombe kikubwa na kirefu kinachochukua mengi. Watu watakucheka na kukudhihaki.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 깊고 넓은 네 언니의 잔을 네가 마실 것이다. 그것이 웃음거리와 조롱거리가 될 것이니, 그만큼 많이 담겼다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너는 깊고 넓은 네 언니의 잔을 마실 것이다. 그 잔에는 많이 담겨 있어서, 너는 비웃음과 조롱을 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너는 네 언니의 잔, 많이 담긴 크고 깊은 잔으로 마실 것이다. 사람들이 너를 비웃고 놀려 댈 것이다.

decisions.choice: it will be for laughter and scorn: Jerusalem will become an object of mockery
alternatives: "you will be laughed at and scorned" (taking the verb as "you will be")
decisions.reason: The verb can be read "it will be" or "you will be". Either way the sense is the same: the cup brings disgrace. Many think the phrase about laughter breaks the description of the cup and may be out of place; the text is followed as it stands.

decisions.choice: the cup of your sister: Samaria's fate
decisions.reason: Jerusalem will suffer what Samaria suffered (verses 9-10). Verses 32-34 have the short lines and repeated sounds of a poem.

source.text: שִׁכָּר֥וֹן וְיָג֖וֹן תִּמָּלֵ֑אִי כּ֚וֹס שַׁמָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָ֔ה כּ֖וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ֥ךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: With drunkenness and grief you will be filled, a cup of horror and desolation, [the] cup of your sister Samaria.

en.L: With drunkenness and sorrow you will be filled; a cup of horror and desolation [is] the cup of your sister Samaria.
en.B: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. It is a cup of horror and ruin, the cup of your sister Samaria.
en.R: You will become drunk and full of sorrow. Your sister Samaria's cup is a cup of terror and ruin.

fr.L: D’ivresse et de chagrin tu seras remplie ; coupe d’horreur et de désolation, la coupe de ta sœur Samarie.
fr.B: Tu seras remplie d’ivresse et de chagrin. C’est une coupe d’horreur et de ruine, la coupe de ta sœur Samarie.
fr.R: Tu deviendras ivre et pleine de chagrin. La coupe de ta sœur Samarie est une coupe de terreur et de ruine.

es.L: De embriaguez y de dolor serás llena; copa de horror y de desolación [es] la copa de tu hermana Samaria.
es.B: Te llenarás de embriaguez y de dolor. Es una copa de horror y de ruina, la copa de tu hermana Samaria.
es.R: Te emborracharás y te llenarás de tristeza. La copa de tu hermana Samaria es una copa de terror y de ruina.

sw.L: Utajazwa ulevi na huzuni; kikombe cha hofu kuu na ukiwa [ndicho] kikombe cha dada yako Samaria.
sw.B: Utajazwa ulevi na huzuni. Ni kikombe cha hofu kuu na maangamizi, kikombe cha dada yako Samaria.
sw.R: Utalewa na kujaa huzuni. Kikombe cha dada yako Samaria ni kikombe cha hofu kuu na maangamizi.

ko.L: 취함과 슬픔으로 네가 가득 찰 것이다. 공포와 황폐의 잔이 네 언니 사마리아의 잔이다.
ko.B: 너는 술에 취하고 슬픔에 가득 찰 것이다. 그것은 공포와 파멸의 잔, 네 언니 사마리아의 잔이다.
ko.R: 너는 술에 취하고 슬픔으로 가득해질 것이다. 네 언니 사마리아의 잔은 공포와 파멸의 잔이다.

decisions.choice: horror and desolation: a play on two similar words
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words for "horror" and "desolation" sound alike. Together they mean a ruin so complete that it appalls everyone who sees it (5:15; Jeremiah 25:11).

decisions.choice: horror y desolación (L); horror y ruina (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on two similar words; Spanish cannot keep the sound, so it keeps a pair of strong words.

source.text: וְשָׁתִ֨ית אוֹתָ֜הּ וּמָצִ֗ית וְאֶת־חֲרָשֶׂ֛יהָ תְּגָרֵ֖מִי וְשָׁדַ֣יִךְ תְּנַתֵּ֑קִי כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will drink it and drain [it], and its fragments you will gnaw, and your breasts you will tear; for I have spoken, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And you will drink it and drain [it], and its fragments you will gnaw, and your breasts you will tear; for I have spoken, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You will drink it and drain it dry; you will chew on its broken pieces and tear at your breasts. For I have spoken, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will drink it all. Then you will chew on the broken pieces of the cup and tear at your own breasts. I have spoken, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et tu la boiras et tu [la] videras, et ses tessons tu les rongeras, et tes seins tu les déchireras ; car moi, j’ai parlé, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu la boiras et tu la videras jusqu’au fond ; tu mâcheras ses morceaux et tu te déchireras les seins. Car moi, j’ai parlé, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tu la boiras entièrement. Ensuite, tu mâcheras les morceaux de la coupe cassée et tu te déchireras la poitrine. C’est moi qui le dis, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y la beberás y [la] apurarás, y sus pedazos roerás, y tus pechos desgarrarás; porque yo he hablado, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: La beberás hasta la última gota; morderás sus pedazos y te desgarrarás los pechos. Porque yo he hablado, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Te la beberás toda. Luego morderás los pedazos rotos de la copa y te desgarrarás tus propios pechos. Yo lo he dicho, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nawe utakinywa na kukimaliza, na vipande vyake utavitafuna, na matiti yako utayararua; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimesema, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Utakinywa na kukimaliza kabisa; utavitafuna vipande vyake vilivyovunjika na kuyararua matiti yako. Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimesema, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Utakinywa chote. Kisha utavitafuna vipande vilivyovunjika vya kikombe hicho na kuyararua matiti yako mwenyewe. Mimi nimesema, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그것을 마시고 [다] 비울 것이며, 그 조각들을 씹고, 네 가슴을 쥐어뜯을 것이다. 내가 말하였기 때문이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 너는 그 잔을 마시고 바닥까지 비울 것이며, 그 깨진 조각들을 씹고 네 가슴을 쥐어뜯을 것이다. 내가 말했기 때문이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 너는 그 잔을 다 마실 것이다. 그러고 나서 깨진 잔 조각을 씹고 네 가슴을 쥐어뜯을 것이다. 내가 말했다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

decisions.choice: gnawing the fragments, tearing the breasts: wild grief and despair
decisions.reason: The picture is of someone driven to madness by what she has drunk: she gnaws the broken cup and tears at her own body. The breasts that were handled by her lovers (verses 3, 21) are now torn in grief. The verb "gnaw" is rare, and the exact sense is not certain.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּשְׁלִ֥יכִי אוֹתִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְאֶת־תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, also you, bear your lewdness and your prostitutions.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because you have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and cast {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} behind your back, you also must bear your lewdness and your prostitution.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because you have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and thrown {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} behind your back, you must bear the punishment for your lewdness and your prostitution.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: You have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and turned your back on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. So you must suffer the punishment for your shameful ways and your unfaithfulness.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié et que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as jeté derrière ton dos, toi aussi, porte ton infamie et tes prostitutions.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié et que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as rejeté derrière ton dos, tu porteras toi aussi le châtiment de ton infamie et de ta prostitution.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié et tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as tourné le dos. C’est pourquoi tu devras subir la punition de ta conduite honteuse et de ton infidélité.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has echado tras tu espalda, carga tú también con tu lascivia y tus prostituciones.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has echado a tus espaldas, tendrás que cargar con el castigo de tu lascivia y de tu prostitución.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has dado la espalda. Por eso tendrás que sufrir el castigo por tu conducta vergonzosa y tu infidelidad.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu umenisahau na kunitupa nyuma ya mgongo wako, wewe nawe uchukue uasherati wako na ukahaba wako.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kwa kuwa umenisahau na kunitupa nyuma ya mgongo wako, ni lazima ubebe adhabu ya uasherati wako na ukahaba wako.
sw.R: Basi hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Umenisahau na kunipa kisogo. Kwa hiyo ni lazima uteseke kwa adhabu ya njia zako za aibu na kutokuwa mwaminifu kwako.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네가 나를 잊고 나를 네 등 뒤로 던져 버렸으니, 너도 네 음란함과 네 음행을 짊어져라.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네가 나를 잊고 나를 등 뒤로 던져 버렸으니, 너는 네 음란한 짓과 음행의 벌을 짊어져야 한다.
ko.R: 그래서 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너는 나를 잊었고 나에게 등을 돌렸다. 그러니 너는 네 부끄러운 짓과 신실하지 못한 짓에 대한 벌을 받아야 한다.

decisions.choice: cast me behind your back: rejected me with contempt
decisions.reason: The same words are used of Jeroboam in 1 Kings 14:9 and of the people in Nehemiah 9:26.

decisions.choice: bear your lewdness: bear its punishment
decisions.reason: To "bear" a sin is to suffer its consequences (16:58; 44:10, 12).

decisions.choice: the punishment for
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "bear" means here (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת־אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת־אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְהַגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Declare to them, then, their abominations.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? If so, confront them with their detestable practices.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, Son of man, are you ready to judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then tell them about the disgusting things they have done.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : Fils d’homme, jugeras-tu Ohola et Oholiba ? Déclare-leur donc leurs abominations.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : Fils d’homme, veux-tu juger Ohola et Oholiba ? Alors mets-les en face de leurs pratiques détestables.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : Fils d’homme, es-tu prêt à juger Ohola et Oholiba ? Alors parle-leur des choses dégoûtantes qu’elles ont faites.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: Hijo de hombre, ¿juzgarás a Aholá y a Aholibá? Declárales, pues, sus abominaciones.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: Hijo de hombre, ¿vas a juzgar a Aholá y a Aholibá? Si es así, ponlas frente a sus prácticas detestables.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: Hijo de hombre, ¿estás dispuesto a juzgar a Aholá y a Aholibá? Entonces diles las cosas repugnantes que han hecho.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, Mwana wa binadamu, je, utawahukumu Ohola na Oholiba? Basi uwatangazie machukizo yao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia: Mwana wa binadamu, je, utawahukumu Ohola na Oholiba? Kama ndivyo, wakabili kwa matendo yao ya kuchukiza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, Mwana wa binadamu, je, uko tayari kuwahukumu Ohola na Oholiba? Basi waambie mambo ya kinyaa waliyoyafanya.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. 사람의 아들아, 네가 오홀라와 오홀리바를 심판하겠느냐? 그렇다면 그들의 가증한 일들을 그들에게 알려라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. 사람의 아들아, 네가 오홀라와 오홀리바를 심판하겠느냐? 그렇다면 그들이 저지른 역겨운 짓들을 그들 앞에 들이대어라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. 사람의 아들아, 오홀라와 오홀리바를 심판할 준비가 되었느냐? 그렇다면 그들이 저지른 역겨운 일들을 그들에게 말하여라.

decisions.choice: will you judge?: a call to bring the charge, as in 20:4 and 22:2
decisions.reason: A second message begins. It sets out the sisters' crimes in the plain terms of the law (verses 37-39) and then returns to the picture (verses 40-49).

decisions.choice: the LORD's words take no quotation marks
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the book, the LORD's own speech takes no quotation marks, even after "the LORD said to me".

decisions.choice: no quotation marks after 'me dijo'
decisions.reason: As in the English, the LORD's oracle takes no quotation marks, even after a verb of saying.

source.text: כִּ֣י נִאֵ֗פוּ וְדָם֙ בִּֽידֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֶת־גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ן נִאֵ֑פוּ וְגַ֤ם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָֽלְדוּ־לִ֔י הֶעֱבִ֥ירוּ לָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For they have committed adultery, and blood [is] on their hands; and with their idols they have committed adultery; and even their sons whom they bore to me they have made pass over to them for food.

en.L: For they have committed adultery, and blood [is] on their hands; and with their filthy idols they have committed adultery; and even their {{gender:children|sons}} whom they bore to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they have made pass over to them, to be devoured.
en.B: For they have committed adultery, and there is blood on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols, and they have even offered up to them as food the {{gender:children|sons}} they bore to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: They have committed adultery, and they are guilty of murder. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have even sacrificed to their idols the {{gender:children|sons}} they bore to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, as food for the idols.

fr.L: Car elles ont commis l’adultère, et du sang [est] sur leurs mains ; et avec leurs idoles immondes elles ont commis l’adultère ; et même leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avaient enfantés, elles les leur ont fait passer [par le feu] pour être dévorés.
fr.B: Car elles ont commis l’adultère, et il y a du sang sur leurs mains. Elles ont commis l’adultère avec leurs idoles, et elles leur ont même offert en nourriture les {{gender:enfants|fils}} qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avaient donnés.
fr.R: Elles ont commis l’adultère, et elles sont coupables de meurtre. Elles ont commis l’adultère avec leurs idoles. Elles ont même sacrifié à leurs idoles les {{gender:enfants|fils}} qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avaient donnés, pour que les idoles s’en nourrissent.

es.L: Porque han cometido adulterio, y sangre [hay] en sus manos; y con sus ídolos inmundos han cometido adulterio; y aun a sus hijos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} habían dado a luz los han hecho pasar a ellos para que [les] sirvan de comida.
es.B: Porque han cometido adulterio, y hay sangre en sus manos. Han cometido adulterio con sus ídolos, y hasta les han ofrecido como alimento a los hijos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} habían dado a luz.
es.R: Han cometido adulterio, y son culpables de asesinato. Han cometido adulterio con sus ídolos. Hasta les han sacrificado a sus ídolos los hijos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} habían dado, como comida para los ídolos.

sw.L: Kwa maana wamezini, na damu [iko] mikononi mwao; na pamoja na sanamu zao chafu wamezini; na hata wana wao walionizalia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} wamewapitisha kwao, ili waliwe.
sw.B: Kwa maana wamezini, na damu iko mikononi mwao. Wamezini na sanamu zao, na hata wamezitolea kuwa chakula watoto walionizalia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.
sw.R: Wamezini, na wana hatia ya kuua watu. Wamezini na sanamu zao. Hata wamezitolea sanamu zao watoto walionizalia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kuwa dhabihu, ili wawe chakula cha sanamu hizo.

ko.L: 그들이 간음했고 그들의 손에 피가 [묻어] 있기 때문이다. 그들은 그들의 더러운 우상들과 간음했고, 그들이 나에게 낳아 준 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}까지 그것들에게 넘겨 삼키게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 간음했고, 그들의 손에는 피가 묻어 있다. 그들은 우상들과 간음했고, 나에게 낳아 준 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}까지 우상들의 먹이로 바쳤다.
ko.R: 그들은 간음했고, 살인죄를 지었다. 그들은 우상들과 간음했다. 그들은 나에게 낳아 준 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}까지 우상들에게 먹이로 바쳤다.

decisions.choice: adultery with their idols: idolatry as unfaithfulness in marriage
decisions.reason: Here the picture and its meaning are joined: the "adultery" is the worship of idols.

decisions.choice: made their children pass over to them as food: child sacrifice to idols
decisions.reason: The same charge is made in 16:20-21 and 20:26, 31: children born to the LORD's people were given to idols in the fire. The phrase "as food" says that the idols were treated as devouring them.

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: Child sacrifice took daughters as well as sons (16:20; Jeremiah 7:31), so the inclusive word is used, with "sons" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: hijos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish 'hijos' already includes daughters, so no gender span is used where the English has one.

source.text: ע֥וֹד זֹ֖את עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֑י טִמְּא֤וּ אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary on the same day, and my sabbaths they have profaned.

en.L: Moreover, this too they have done to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: they have defiled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary on that same day, and they have profaned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths.
en.B: They have also done this to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: on that same day they defiled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary and dishonored {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths.
en.R: They have also done this to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. On the same day they sacrificed their children, they made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple unclean. They also treated {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbath days with no respect.

fr.L: De plus, voici encore ce qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont fait : elles ont souillé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire en ce même jour, et elles ont profané {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats.
fr.B: Voici encore ce qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont fait : ce jour-là même, elles ont souillé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire et déshonoré {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats.
fr.R: Voici encore ce qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont fait. Le jour même où elles ont sacrifié leurs enfants, elles ont rendu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple impur. Elles n’ont eu aucun respect pour {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jours de sabbat.

es.L: Además, esto {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han hecho: han contaminado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario en ese mismo día, y han profanado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados.
es.B: También {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han hecho esto: ese mismo día contaminaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario y deshonraron {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados.
es.R: También {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han hecho esto: el mismo día en que sacrificaron a sus hijos, hicieron impuro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo. Tampoco respetaron {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados.

sw.L: Zaidi ya hayo, hili nalo wamenitendea: wamepatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} siku ile ile, na Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wamezitia unajisi.
sw.B: Pia wamenitendea hili: siku ile ile walipatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} na kuzivunjia heshima Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.R: Pia wamenitendea hili: siku ile ile walipowatoa watoto wao dhabihu, walilifanya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kuwa najisi. Tena hawakuziheshimu siku {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za Sabato.

ko.L: 또 그들이 나에게 이런 일을 했다. 그들은 바로 그날 내 성소를 더럽혔고, 내 안식일들을 더럽혔다.
ko.B: 그들은 또 나에게 이런 짓을 했다. 그들은 바로 그날 내 성소를 더럽혔고 내 안식일을 더럽혔다.
ko.R: 그들은 나에게 또 이런 짓을 했다. 자기 자녀들을 제물로 바친 바로 그날 그들은 내 성전을 더럽혔다. 그들은 내 안식일도 존중하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: on that same day: the day of the child sacrifices (verse 39)
decisions.reason: The next verse explains: they came straight from killing their children to the LORD's house.

decisions.choice: On the same day they sacrificed their children
decisions.reason: Readable says which day is meant, from verse 39 (m1).

source.text: וּֽבְשַׁחֲטָ֤ם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם֙ לְגִלּ֣וּלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לְחַלְּל֑וֹ וְהִנֵּה־כֹ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And when they slaughtered their sons to their idols, they came into my sanctuary on the same day to profane it; and behold, thus they did in [the] midst of my house.

en.L: And when they had slaughtered their {{gender:children|sons}} to their filthy idols, they came into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary on that same day to profane it; and see, this is what they did in the midst of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house.
en.B: After they had slaughtered their {{gender:children|sons}} for their idols, they came into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary that same day and profaned it. That is what they did inside {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house!
en.R: They killed their {{gender:children|sons}} as sacrifices to their idols. Then on that same day they came into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple and treated it as if it were not holy. That is what they did inside {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house!

fr.L: Et quand elles avaient égorgé leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour leurs idoles immondes, elles sont venues dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire ce même jour pour le profaner ; et voici, c’est ce qu’elles ont fait au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison.
fr.B: Après avoir égorgé leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour leurs idoles, elles sont venues ce jour-là même dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire et l’ont profané. Voilà ce qu’elles ont fait à l’intérieur de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison !
fr.R: Elles ont tué leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} en sacrifice à leurs idoles. Puis, le même jour, elles sont venues dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple et l’ont traité comme s’il n’était pas saint. Voilà ce qu’elles ont fait à l’intérieur de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison !

es.L: Y cuando habían degollado a sus hijos para sus ídolos inmundos, entraban en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario ese mismo día para profanarlo; y mira, así hicieron en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa.
es.B: Después de degollar a sus hijos para sus ídolos, entraron ese mismo día en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario y lo profanaron. ¡Eso es lo que hicieron dentro de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa!
es.R: Mataron a sus hijos como sacrificio a sus ídolos. Luego, ese mismo día, entraron en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo y lo trataron como si no fuera santo. ¡Eso es lo que hicieron dentro de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa!

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wamewachinja wana wao kwa sanamu zao chafu, waliingia patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} siku ile ile ili kupatia unajisi; na tazama, ndivyo walivyofanya katikati ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Baada ya kuwachinja watoto wao kwa ajili ya sanamu zao, waliingia patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} siku ile ile na kupatia unajisi. Hivyo ndivyo walivyofanya ndani ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!
sw.R: Waliwaua watoto wao kuwa dhabihu kwa sanamu zao. Kisha siku ile ile wakaingia hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}} na kulitendea kana kwamba si takatifu. Hivyo ndivyo walivyofanya ndani ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그들의 더러운 우상들에게 그들의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}을 잡아 바친 그날에, 그들이 내 성소에 들어와 그것을 더럽혔다. 그리고 보라, 그들이 내 집 가운데서 이렇게 행했다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}을 잡아 우상들에게 바친 뒤에, 바로 그날 내 성소에 들어와 그곳을 더럽혔다. 그들이 내 집 안에서 이런 짓을 했다!
ko.R: 그들은 자기 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}을 죽여 우상들에게 제물로 바쳤다. 그러고는 바로 그날 내 성전에 들어와 그곳을 거룩하지 않은 곳처럼 다루었다. 그들이 내 집 안에서 이런 짓을 했다!

decisions.choice: from the idol's altar to the LORD's house: worship mixed with murder
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 7:9-11 makes the same charge: people steal, murder and serve Baal, and then come and stand before God in the temple and say, "We are safe".

source.text: וְאַ֗ף כִּ֤י תִשְׁלַ֨חְנָה֙ לַֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַלְאָ֜ךְ שָׁל֤וּחַ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְהִנֵּה־בָ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָחַ֛צְתְּ כָּחַ֥לְתְּ עֵינַ֖יִךְ וְעָ֥דִית עֶֽדִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And moreover they sent for men coming from afar, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you bathed, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments.

en.L: And moreover, they sent for men to come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and see, they came; for whom you bathed, painted your eyes and adorned yourself with ornaments.
en.B: They even sent for men to come from far away; a messenger was sent to them, and they came. For them you bathed, painted your eyes and put on your jewelry.
en.R: They even sent messengers to bring men from far away, and the men came. You bathed for them, put on eye makeup and wore your jewelry.

fr.L: Et de plus, elles ont envoyé chercher des hommes venant de loin, vers qui un messager avait été envoyé, et voici, ils sont venus ; pour eux tu t’es baignée, tu as fardé tes yeux et tu t’es parée de bijoux.
fr.B: Elles ont même fait venir des hommes de loin ; on leur a envoyé un messager, et ils sont venus. Pour eux, tu t’es baignée, tu t’es maquillé les yeux et tu as mis tes bijoux.
fr.R: Elles ont même envoyé des messagers chercher des hommes très loin, et ces hommes sont venus. Pour eux, tu t’es baignée, tu t’es maquillé les yeux et tu as mis tes bijoux.

es.L: Y además, mandaron a buscar a hombres que vinieran de lejos, a los cuales se había enviado un mensajero, y mira, vinieron; para ellos te bañaste, te pintaste los ojos y te adornaste con joyas.
es.B: Hasta mandaron a buscar a hombres que vinieran de lejos; se les envió un mensajero, y vinieron. Para ellos te bañaste, te pintaste los ojos y te pusiste tus joyas.
es.R: Hasta enviaron mensajeros a traer hombres de lejos, y los hombres vinieron. Te bañaste para ellos, te maquillaste los ojos y te pusiste tus joyas.

sw.L: Na zaidi ya hayo, walituma kuwaita watu waje kutoka mbali, ambao mjumbe alitumwa kwao, na tazama, wakaja; ambao kwa ajili yao ulioga, ukapaka macho yako wanja, ukajipamba kwa mapambo.
sw.B: Hata waliwatumia watu wa mbali waje; mjumbe alitumwa kwao, nao wakaja. Kwa ajili yao ulioga, ukapaka macho yako wanja na kuvaa vito vyako.
sw.R: Hata walituma wajumbe kuwaleta wanaume kutoka mbali, nao wanaume hao wakaja. Uliwaogea, ukajipaka wanja machoni na kuvaa vito vyako.

ko.L: 그리고 또 그들이 멀리서 오는 사람들을 불렀으니, 그들에게 사자가 보내졌고, 보라, 그들이 왔다. 너는 그들을 위하여 목욕하고, 눈을 칠하고, 장신구로 단장했다.
ko.B: 그들은 멀리서 사람들을 불러오기까지 했다. 그들에게 사자를 보내자 그들이 왔다. 너는 그들을 위해 목욕하고, 눈화장을 하고, 장신구로 꾸몄다.
ko.R: 그들은 멀리 있는 남자들을 데려오려고 사자들을 보내기까지 했다. 그러자 그 남자들이 왔다. 너는 그들을 위해 목욕하고, 눈화장을 하고, 장신구를 걸쳤다.

decisions.choice: men from far away, sent for by messenger: envoys from foreign powers
decisions.reason: Behind the picture are Judah's embassies to distant nations seeking alliances (verse 16; Isaiah 57:9).

decisions.choice: bathing, painting the eyes, putting on jewelry: a woman preparing for her lovers
decisions.reason: Eye paint was worn to look attractive, as Jezebel did (2 Kings 9:30); Jeremiah 4:30 uses the same picture of Jerusalem dressing up for lovers who despise her.

decisions.choice: you bathed: the address changes from "they" to "you"
decisions.reason: The verse moves from the two sisters ("they sent") to one woman addressed directly ("you bathed"). Such shifts are frequent in this part of the chapter, and the picture is of the two cities as one.

source.text: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ֙ עַל־מִטָּ֣ה כְבוּדָּ֔ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֥ן עָר֖וּךְ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וּקְטָרְתִּ֥י וְשַׁמְנִ֖י שַׂ֥מְתְּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you sat on a glorious couch, and a table arranged before it, and my incense and my oil you set on it.

en.L: And you sat on a splendid couch, with a table spread before it, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} incense and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} oil you set on it.
en.B: You sat on a splendid couch with a table laid out in front of it, where you had placed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} incense and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} oil.
en.R: You sat on a fine couch with a table set in front of it. On the table you put the incense and olive oil that belonged to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Et tu t’es assise sur un lit magnifique, avec une table dressée devant lui, et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} encens et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} huile, tu les as placés dessus.
fr.B: Tu t’es assise sur un lit magnifique devant une table dressée, où tu avais posé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} encens et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} huile.
fr.R: Tu t’es assise sur un beau lit, avec une table servie devant toi. Sur la table, tu as mis l’encens et l’huile d’olive qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartenaient.

es.L: Y te sentaste en un lecho espléndido, con una mesa preparada delante de él, y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} incienso y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} aceite pusiste sobre ella.
es.B: Te sentaste en un diván espléndido con una mesa preparada delante, donde habías puesto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} incienso y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} aceite.
es.R: Te sentaste en un diván fino con una mesa delante. Sobre la mesa pusiste el incienso y el aceite de oliva que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecían.

sw.L: Nawe ukaketi juu ya kitanda cha fahari, na meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yake, na uvumba {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na mafuta {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} uliyaweka juu yake.
sw.B: Uliketi juu ya kitanda cha fahari, na mbele yake meza iliyoandaliwa, ambayo juu yake ulikuwa umeweka uvumba {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na mafuta {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Uliketi juu ya kitanda kizuri, na meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yake. Juu ya meza uliweka uvumba na mafuta ya zeituni yaliyokuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 화려한 침상에 앉았고, 그 앞에는 상이 차려져 있었으며, 너는 내 향과 내 기름을 그 위에 두었다.
ko.B: 너는 화려한 침상에 앉았고, 그 앞에는 상이 차려져 있었다. 너는 그 상 위에 내 향과 내 기름을 올려놓았다.
ko.R: 너는 좋은 침상에 앉았고, 그 앞에는 상이 차려져 있었다. 너는 그 상 위에 나에게 바쳐야 할 향과 올리브기름을 올려놓았다.

decisions.choice: a splendid couch and a table spread: a banquet
decisions.reason: Guests at a feast reclined on couches beside a table (Amos 6:4). The woman hosts a banquet for her lovers.

decisions.choice: my incense and my oil: gifts that belonged to God, used for others
decisions.reason: The incense and oil were meant for the LORD's worship, and were his gifts in the first place (16:18-19; Hosea 2:10). Using them for idols or for foreign guests was a further betrayal.

source.text: וְק֣וֹל הָמוֹן֮ שָׁלֵ֣ו בָהּ֒ וְאֶל־אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵרֹ֣ב אָדָ֔ם מוּבָאִ֥ים סָבָאִ֖ים מִמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּתְּנ֤וּ צְמִידִים֙ אֶל־יְדֵיהֶ֔ן וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sound of a crowd at ease [was] with her, and with men from [the] multitude of mankind were brought drunkards from [the] wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands and crowns of beauty on their heads.

en.L: And the sound of a carefree crowd [was] with her; and with men from the common people, drunkards were brought from the wilderness; and they placed bracelets on their hands and crowns of beauty on their heads.
en.B: The noise of a carefree crowd was around her. Along with men from the common people, drunkards were brought in from the desert, and they put bracelets on the women's arms and beautiful crowns on their heads.
en.R: The noise of a crowd having a good time was all around her. Ordinary men were there, and drunkards brought in from the desert. They put bracelets on the sisters' arms and beautiful crowns on their heads.

fr.L: Et le bruit d’une foule insouciante [était] avec elle ; et avec des hommes du commun du peuple, on a amené des ivrognes du désert ; et ils ont mis des bracelets à leurs mains et des couronnes de beauté sur leurs têtes.
fr.B: Le bruit d’une foule insouciante l’entourait. Avec des hommes du commun, on a fait venir des ivrognes du désert, et ils ont mis des bracelets aux bras des femmes et de belles couronnes sur leurs têtes.
fr.R: Le bruit d’une foule qui s’amusait l’entourait. Il y avait là des hommes ordinaires et des ivrognes venus du désert. Ils ont mis des bracelets aux bras des deux sœurs et de belles couronnes sur leurs têtes.

es.L: Y el ruido de una multitud despreocupada [estaba] con ella; y con hombres de la gente común fueron traídos borrachos del desierto; y pusieron brazaletes en sus manos y coronas hermosas sobre sus cabezas.
es.B: El bullicio de una multitud despreocupada la rodeaba. Junto con hombres de la gente común, trajeron borrachos del desierto, y ellos pusieron brazaletes en los brazos de las mujeres y hermosas coronas en sus cabezas.
es.R: Alrededor de ella había el ruido de una multitud que se divertía. Había hombres comunes, y borrachos traídos del desierto. Pusieron brazaletes en los brazos de las dos hermanas y hermosas coronas en sus cabezas.

sw.L: Na sauti ya umati usio na wasiwasi [ilikuwa] pamoja naye; na pamoja na watu wa kawaida, walevi waliletwa kutoka nyikani; nao wakaweka bangili mikononi mwao na taji za uzuri vichwani mwao.
sw.B: Kelele za umati usio na wasiwasi zilimzunguka. Pamoja na watu wa kawaida, walevi waliletwa kutoka jangwani, nao wakawavika wanawake hao bangili mikononi na taji nzuri vichwani.
sw.R: Kelele za umati wa watu wanaostarehe zilimzunguka. Watu wa kawaida walikuwepo, na walevi walioletwa kutoka jangwani. Wakawavika dada hao bangili mikononi na taji nzuri vichwani.

ko.L: 그리고 근심 없는 무리의 소리가 그 여자와 함께 [있었고], 뭇사람 가운데서 [온] 남자들과 함께 광야에서 술 취한 자들이 끌려왔다. 그리고 그들이 그들의 손에 팔찌를 끼우고, 그들의 머리에 아름다운 관을 씌웠다.
ko.B: 그 여자 주위에서 흥청거리는 무리의 소리가 들렸다. 평범한 사람들 가운데서 온 남자들과 함께 광야에서 술 취한 자들도 끌려왔다. 그들은 그 여자들의 팔에 팔찌를 끼우고 머리에 아름다운 관을 씌웠다.
ko.R: 그 여자 주위에서는 즐겁게 떠드는 무리의 소리가 들렸다. 평범한 남자들도 있었고, 광야에서 데려온 술꾼들도 있었다. 그들은 두 자매의 팔에 팔찌를 끼워 주고 머리에 아름다운 관을 씌워 주었다.

decisions.choice: drunkards from the wilderness: the written Hebrew text
alternatives: "Sabeans from the wilderness" (the Hebrew text as traditionally read aloud), meaning traders from Sheba in Arabia
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text is written with a word for "drunkards", but the margin of the Hebrew manuscripts tells readers to read "Sabeans", people of Sheba, who traded across the Arabian desert. The two words differ in one letter. The verse is hard, and either reading fits a rowdy crowd of all kinds of men.

decisions.choice: their hands, their heads: the two sisters
alternatives: the men's own hands and heads
decisions.reason: The men put bracelets and crowns on the women, as gifts to the prostitutes. The pronoun could refer to the men, but the gifts fit the picture of lovers paying the women.

decisions.choice: the women's arms (B); the sisters' arms (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose arms are meant (m2).

source.text: וָאֹמַ֕ר לַבָּלָ֖ה נִֽאוּפִ֑ים עַתָּ֛ה יִזְנ֥וּ תַזְנוּתֶ֖הָ וָהִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said of [her who was] worn out [with] adulteries, Now they will commit her prostitution, even she.

en.L: And I said of [the one] worn out [with] adulteries, "Now they will commit prostitution with her, even with her!"
en.B: Then I said of the woman worn out by adulteries, "Even now men will commit prostitution with her!"
en.R: Then I said about this woman, who was worn out by her adulteries, "Even now men will still use her as a prostitute!"

fr.L: Et j’ai dit de [celle qui était] usée [par] les adultères : « Maintenant ils se prostitueront avec elle, même avec elle ! »
fr.B: Alors j’ai dit de cette femme usée par les adultères : « Même maintenant, des hommes vont se prostituer avec elle ! »
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit de cette femme, usée par ses adultères : « Même maintenant, des hommes vont encore se servir d’elle comme d’une prostituée ! »

es.L: Y dije de [la que estaba] gastada [por los] adulterios: «Ahora cometerán prostitución con ella, ¡aun con ella!».
es.B: Entonces dije de la mujer gastada por los adulterios: «¡Aun ahora los hombres se prostituirán con ella!».
es.R: Entonces dije de esta mujer, gastada por sus adulterios: «¡Aun ahora los hombres la siguen usando como prostituta!».

sw.L: Nami nikasema juu ya [yule] aliyechakaa [kwa] uzinzi, "Sasa watafanya ukahaba naye, hata yeye!"
sw.B: Ndipo nikasema juu ya mwanamke yule aliyechakaa kwa uzinzi, "Hata sasa wanaume watafanya ukahaba naye!"
sw.R: Ndipo nikasema juu ya mwanamke huyu aliyechakaa kwa uzinzi wake, "Hata sasa wanaume bado watamtumia kama kahaba!"

ko.L: 그래서 내가 간음으로 닳아 버린 [여자에] 대하여 말했다. "이제 그들이 그 여자와, 바로 그 여자와 음행할 것이다!"
ko.B: 그때 나는 간음으로 지쳐 버린 그 여자를 두고 말했다. "이제도 남자들이 그 여자와 음행하겠구나!"
ko.R: 그때 나는 간음으로 지칠 대로 지친 이 여자를 두고 말했다. "이제도 남자들이 이 여자를 창녀처럼 이용하겠구나!"

decisions.choice: the woman worn out by adulteries is still sought by lovers: the Hebrew is very obscure
alternatives: "Will she now still play the prostitute?" (a question)
"Now she will carry on her prostitution" (reading the verb differently, as the text's margin does)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is broken and hard to construe; the written text and the reading in the margin differ in the verb. The drafted sense is that the LORD marvels that men still come to a woman worn out by her many adulteries. No reading is certain.

decisions.choice: the LORD's earlier words in double quotes
decisions.reason: These are words the LORD once said, quoted inside his speech, so they take double quotes.

decisions.choice: the LORD's earlier words in « »
decisions.reason: Here God quotes what he once said, so those words are set in « », as the English sets them in double quotes.

source.text: וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֔יהָ כְּב֖וֹא אֶל־אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן בָּ֗אוּ אֶֽל־אָֽהֳלָה֙ וְאֶל־אָ֣הֳלִיבָ֔ה אִשֹּׁ֖ת הַזִּמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went in to her as [one] goes in to a woman, a prostitute; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the women of lewdness.

en.L: And they went in to her as [one] goes in to a prostitute; thus they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, women of lewdness.
en.B: Men went to bed with her as they would with a prostitute; in the same way they went to Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
en.R: Men had sex with her as they would with a prostitute. That is how they treated Oholah and Oholibah, those shameful women.

fr.L: Et ils sont entrés vers elle comme [on] entre vers une femme prostituée ; ainsi ils sont entrés vers Ohola et vers Oholiba, femmes d’infamie.
fr.B: Des hommes ont couché avec elle comme on couche avec une prostituée ; c’est ainsi qu’ils sont allés vers Ohola et Oholiba, ces femmes infâmes.
fr.R: Des hommes ont eu des relations sexuelles avec elle comme avec une prostituée. C’est ainsi qu’ils ont traité Ohola et Oholiba, ces femmes à la conduite honteuse.

es.L: Y entraron a ella como se entra a una mujer prostituta; así entraron a Aholá y a Aholibá, mujeres lascivas.
es.B: Los hombres se acostaron con ella como se acuestan con una prostituta; de la misma manera se acostaron con Aholá y con Aholibá, esas mujeres lascivas.
es.R: Los hombres tuvieron relaciones sexuales con ella como las tienen con una prostituta. Así trataron a Aholá y a Aholibá, esas mujeres de conducta vergonzosa.

sw.L: Nao wakaingia kwake kama mtu aingiavyo kwa kahaba; ndivyo walivyoingia kwa Ohola na kwa Oholiba, wanawake wa uasherati.
sw.B: Wanaume walilala naye kama wanavyolala na kahaba; vivyo hivyo walikwenda kwa Ohola na Oholiba, wanawake wale waasherati.
sw.R: Wanaume walilala naye kama wanavyolala na kahaba. Hivyo ndivyo walivyowatendea Ohola na Oholiba, wanawake wale wa aibu.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 창녀에게 들어가듯이 그 여자에게 들어갔다. 이와 같이 그들이 음란한 여자들인 오홀라와 오홀리바에게 들어갔다.
ko.B: 남자들은 창녀와 동침하듯이 그 여자와 동침했다. 그와 같이 그들은 음란한 여자들인 오홀라와 오홀리바와 동침했다.
ko.R: 남자들은 창녀와 성관계를 가지듯이 그 여자와 성관계를 가졌다. 그들은 부끄러운 짓을 한 그 여자들, 오홀라와 오홀리바를 그렇게 대했다.

decisions.choice: went in to her: had sexual relations with her
decisions.reason: "Go in to" a woman is the usual Hebrew way of saying to have relations with her (Genesis 16:2; 29:23).

decisions.choice: went in to (L); went to bed with (B); had sex with (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom. Balanced and Readable state the meaning plainly, in the register set for the chapter.

decisions.choice: entraron a (L); se acostaron con (B); tuvieron relaciones sexuales con (R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the Hebrew idiom; B uses the plain, polite Spanish phrase; R says what it means.

decisions.choice: went in to: 들어가다 (L); 동침하다 (B); 성관계를 가지다 (R)
decisions.reason: As the English register decision: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom, Balanced and Readable say it plainly, in the words Korean Leviticus uses.

source.text: וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים צַדִּיקִ֗ם הֵ֚מָּה יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ אֽוֹתְהֶ֔ם מִשְׁפַּט֙ נֹֽאֲפ֔וֹת וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט שֹׁפְכ֣וֹת דָּ֑ם כִּ֤י נֹֽאֲפֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְדָ֖ם בִּֽידֵיהֶֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But righteous men, they will judge them [with the] judgment of adulteresses and [the] judgment of [women who] shed blood, because adulteresses they [are], and blood [is] on their hands.

en.L: But righteous men, they will judge them [with] the sentence of adulteresses and the sentence of [women who] shed blood; for adulteresses they [are], and blood [is] on their hands.
en.B: But righteous men will sentence them as adulteresses and as women who shed blood are sentenced, because they are adulteresses and there is blood on their hands.
en.R: But men who do what is right will sentence them to the punishment that women receive for adultery and murder. They have committed adultery, and they have blood on their hands.

fr.L: Mais des hommes justes, eux, les jugeront [selon] le jugement des adultères et le jugement des [femmes qui] répandent le sang ; car elles [sont] adultères, et du sang [est] sur leurs mains.
fr.B: Mais des hommes justes les condamneront comme on condamne les femmes adultères et les femmes qui répandent le sang, car elles sont adultères et il y a du sang sur leurs mains.
fr.R: Mais des hommes qui font ce qui est juste les condamneront à la punition que reçoivent les femmes coupables d’adultère et de meurtre. Elles ont commis l’adultère, et elles ont du sang sur les mains.

es.L: Pero hombres justos, ellos las juzgarán [con] la sentencia de adúlteras y la sentencia de [mujeres que] derraman sangre; porque adúlteras [son], y sangre [hay] en sus manos.
es.B: Pero hombres justos las condenarán como se condena a las adúlteras y a las mujeres que derraman sangre, porque son adúlteras y hay sangre en sus manos.
es.R: Pero hombres que hacen lo que es justo las condenarán al castigo que reciben las mujeres por adulterio y asesinato. Han cometido adulterio y tienen las manos manchadas de sangre.

sw.L: Lakini watu wenye haki, wao watawahukumu [kwa] hukumu ya wazinzi na hukumu ya [wanawake wanaomwaga] damu; kwa maana wao [ni] wazinzi, na damu [iko] mikononi mwao.
sw.B: Lakini watu wenye haki watawahukumu kama wanavyohukumiwa wanawake wazinzi na wanawake wanaomwaga damu, kwa sababu wao ni wazinzi na damu iko mikononi mwao.
sw.R: Lakini watu wanaotenda haki watawahukumu adhabu wanayopewa wanawake waliozini na kuua. Wamezini, na mikono yao ina damu.

ko.L: 그러나 의로운 사람들, 그들이 간음한 여자들의 판결과 피를 흘린 [여자들의] 판결로 그들을 심판할 것이다. 그들은 간음한 여자들이고, 그들의 손에 피가 [묻어] 있기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 의로운 사람들이 간음한 여자들과 피를 흘린 여자들에게 내리는 판결로 그들을 심판할 것이다. 그들은 간음한 여자들이고, 그들의 손에는 피가 묻어 있기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 옳은 일을 하는 사람들이 그들에게 간음과 살인을 저지른 여자들이 받는 벌을 내릴 것이다. 그들은 간음했고, 그들의 손에는 피가 묻어 있다.

decisions.choice: righteous men: those who judge rightly, measured by the law
alternatives: the nations, called righteous by comparison with Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The sentence is just: even the instruments of judgment can be called "righteous" in comparison with the sisters, as 16:51-52 says that Jerusalem made her sisters look righteous. Who the righteous men are is not said.

decisions.choice: the judgment of adulteresses and of those who shed blood
decisions.reason: The law punished adultery (Leviticus 20:10; Deuteronomy 22:22) and murder (Genesis 9:6) with death. The same sentence is passed in 16:38.

source.text: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הַעֲלֵ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קָהָ֔ל וְנָתֹ֥ן אֶתְהֶ֖ן לְזַעֲוָ֥ה וְלָבַֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Bring up against them an assembly, and give them to terror and to plunder.

en.L: For thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Bring up an assembly against them, and give them over to terror and to plunder.
en.B: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Bring up a crowd against them, and hand them over to terror and plunder.
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Bring a crowd together against them. Let them be terrified and robbed.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Fais monter contre elles une assemblée, et livre-les à l’épouvante et au pillage.
fr.B: Car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Fais monter contre elles une foule, et livre-les à l’épouvante et au pillage.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Rassemble une foule contre elles. Qu’elles soient terrifiées et pillées.

es.L: Porque así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Haz subir contra ellas una asamblea, y entrégalas al terror y al saqueo.
es.B: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Haz venir contra ellas una multitud y entrégalas al terror y al saqueo.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Reúne una multitud contra ellas. Que sean aterrorizadas y saqueadas.

sw.L: Kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Pandisha kusanyiko dhidi yao, na uwatoe kwa hofu na kwa nyara.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Leta umati dhidi yao, na uwatoe watiwe hofu na kutekwa nyara.
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Kusanya umati wa watu dhidi yao. Waache watishwe na kunyang'anywa mali zao.

ko.L: 참으로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 그들을 치려고 무리를 올라오게 하고, 그들을 공포와 약탈에 넘겨라.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 그들을 치려고 무리를 불러올려라. 그들을 공포와 약탈에 넘겨주어라.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 무리를 모아 그들을 치게 하여라. 그들이 공포에 떨고 약탈을 당하게 하여라.

decisions.choice: bring up, give over: commands, or "I will bring up"
decisions.reason: The verbs are a form that can be a command or a statement of what will happen. Either way the LORD is the one who brings the judgment.

decisions.choice: an assembly: a gathered crowd that carries out a sentence
decisions.reason: The word is used for the community gathered for judgment (16:40; Numbers 15:35-36). Here it also suggests the gathered army of the nations.

source.text: וְרָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ן אֶ֨בֶן֙ קָהָ֔ל וּבָרֵ֥א אוֹתְהֶ֖ן בְּחַרְבוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ן בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will stone them with stones [the] assembly, and cut them down with their swords; their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses with fire they will burn.

en.L: And the assembly will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
en.B: The crowd will stone them and hack them down with their swords; their sons and daughters they will kill, and their houses they will set on fire.
en.R: The crowd will throw stones at them and kill them with swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses with fire.

fr.L: Et l’assemblée les lapidera avec des pierres et les taillera en pièces avec leurs épées ; leurs fils et leurs filles, ils les tueront, et leurs maisons, ils les brûleront au feu.
fr.B: La foule les lapidera et les taillera en pièces avec ses épées ; elle tuera leurs fils et leurs filles et mettra le feu à leurs maisons.
fr.R: La foule leur jettera des pierres et les tuera avec des épées. Ils tueront leurs fils et leurs filles et brûleront leurs maisons.

es.L: Y la asamblea las apedreará con piedras y las despedazará con sus espadas; a sus hijos y a sus hijas matarán, y sus casas quemarán con fuego.
es.B: La multitud las apedreará y las despedazará con sus espadas; matarán a sus hijos y a sus hijas, y prenderán fuego a sus casas.
es.R: La multitud les tirará piedras y las matará con espadas. Matarán a sus hijos y a sus hijas y quemarán sus casas.

sw.L: Na kusanyiko litawapiga kwa mawe na kuwakatakata kwa panga zao; wana wao na binti zao watawaua, na nyumba zao watazichoma kwa moto.
sw.B: Umati utawapiga kwa mawe na kuwakatakata kwa panga zao; watawaua wana wao na binti zao, na kuziteketeza nyumba zao kwa moto.
sw.R: Umati utawatupia mawe na kuwaua kwa panga. Watawaua wana wao na binti zao na kuziteketeza nyumba zao kwa moto.

ko.L: 그리고 그 무리가 그들을 돌로 치고, 그들의 칼로 그들을 베어 버릴 것이다. 그들의 아들들과 딸들을 그들이 죽이고, 그들의 집들을 불로 태울 것이다.
ko.B: 그 무리가 그들을 돌로 치고 칼로 베어 쓰러뜨릴 것이다. 그들은 그 여자들의 아들딸들을 죽이고 집들을 불태울 것이다.
ko.R: 그 무리는 그들에게 돌을 던지고 칼로 그들을 죽일 것이다. 그들은 그 여자들의 아들딸들을 죽이고 집들을 불로 태울 것이다.

decisions.choice: stoning: the law's penalty for adultery and idolatry
decisions.reason: The law ordered stoning for adultery (Deuteronomy 22:21-24) and for giving children to Molech (Leviticus 20:2). In the history behind the picture, the city's people were killed and its houses burned by the Babylonians (2 Kings 25:9).

source.text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנִֽוַּסְּרוּ֙ כָּל־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will put an end to lewdness from the land, and will be warned all the women, and will not do according to your lewdness.

en.L: And I will put an end to lewdness in the land, and all the women will take warning and not commit lewdness like yours.
en.B: So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, and all women will take warning and not act as lewdly as you did.
en.R: In this way I will put an end to shameful ways in the land. All women will learn from this, and they will not do the shameful things you have done.

fr.L: Et je ferai cesser l’infamie dans le pays, et toutes les femmes seront averties et ne commettront pas d’infamie comme la vôtre.
fr.B: Ainsi je mettrai fin à l’infamie dans le pays, et toutes les femmes seront averties et n’agiront pas avec autant d’infamie que vous.
fr.R: De cette manière, je mettrai fin à la conduite honteuse dans le pays. Toutes les femmes tireront la leçon de cela, et elles ne feront pas les choses honteuses que vous avez faites.

es.L: Y pondré fin a la lascivia en la tierra, y todas las mujeres escarmentarán y no harán conforme a {{plural_you:su lascivia|vuestra lascivia}}.
es.B: Así pondré fin a la lascivia en la tierra, y todas las mujeres escarmentarán y no actuarán con la lascivia con que {{plural_you:ustedes actuaron|vosotras actuasteis}}.
es.R: De esta manera pondré fin a la conducta vergonzosa en la tierra. Todas las mujeres aprenderán de esto y no harán las cosas vergonzosas que {{plural_you:ustedes hicieron|vosotras hicisteis}}.

sw.L: Nami nitaukomesha uasherati katika nchi, na wanawake wote watapata onyo, wala hawatafanya uasherati kama wako.
sw.B: Hivyo nitaukomesha uasherati katika nchi, na wanawake wote watapata onyo, wala hawatafanya uasherati kama ulivyofanya.
sw.R: Kwa njia hii nitazikomesha njia za aibu katika nchi. Wanawake wote watajifunza kutokana na hili, nao hawatafanya mambo ya aibu uliyoyafanya.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그 땅에서 음란함을 그치게 하겠다. 그러면 모든 여자가 경고를 받고 너희의 음란함대로 행하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 내가 그 땅에서 음란한 짓을 끝내겠다. 그러면 모든 여자가 경고를 받아 너희처럼 음란하게 행하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 이렇게 해서 나는 그 땅에서 부끄러운 짓을 끝내겠다. 모든 여자가 이 일에서 교훈을 얻어, 너희가 한 부끄러운 짓을 하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: all the women: within the picture, the other cities and peoples who watch Jerusalem's fall
alternatives: a direct warning to women in Israel
decisions.reason: The "women" belong to the picture, as in 16:41, where Jerusalem is punished "in the sight of many women". The chapter is about the faithlessness of Samaria and Jerusalem toward God and what it brought on them. It is not a rule for how husbands may treat their wives, and it gives no one license to harm a woman.

decisions.choice: I will put an end to lewdness in the land: judgment ends the idolatry
decisions.reason: As in verse 27, the judgment will end the long history of unfaithfulness.

decisions.choice: plural 'you' addressed to the two women: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}, feminine
decisions.reason: In verses 48-49 the Hebrew 'you' is feminine plural, the two sisters, so the vosotros alternative is feminine.

source.text: וְנָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְכֶ֨נָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ן וַחֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they will put your lewdness upon you, and [the] sins of your idols you will bear; and you will know that I [am the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And they will bring your lewdness back on you, and you will bear the sins of your filthy idols; and you will know that I [am] the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Your lewdness will be repaid on you, and you will bear the penalty for your sins with idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will be punished for your shameful ways and for your sins of worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et ils feront retomber sur vous votre infamie, et vous porterez les péchés de vos idoles immondes ; et vous saurez que je [suis] le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Votre infamie retombera sur vous, et vous porterez le châtiment de vos péchés d’idolâtrie. Alors vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous serez punies pour votre conduite honteuse et pour vos péchés, quand vous adoriez des idoles. Alors vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} harán recaer {{plural_you:su lascivia|vuestra lascivia}}, y los pecados de {{plural_you:sus ídolos inmundos|vuestros ídolos inmundos}} {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}}; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Su lascivia|Vuestra lascivia}} recaerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}, y {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con el castigo de {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}} de idolatría. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Serán castigadas|Seréis castigadas}} por {{plural_you:su conducta vergonzosa|vuestra conducta vergonzosa}} y por {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}} de adorar ídolos. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nao watauleta uasherati wenu juu yenu, nanyi mtazibeba dhambi za sanamu zenu chafu; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Uasherati wenu utalipizwa juu yenu, nanyi mtaibeba adhabu ya dhambi zenu za sanamu. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtaadhibiwa kwa ajili ya njia zenu za aibu na kwa dhambi zenu za kuabudu sanamu. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 너희의 음란함을 너희 위에 돌릴 것이고, 너희는 너희의 더러운 우상들로 [지은] 죄를 짊어질 것이다. 그리고 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 너희의 음란한 짓은 너희가 그대로 갚음을 받을 것이고, 너희는 우상들과 함께 지은 죄의 벌을 짊어질 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 너희의 부끄러운 짓과 우상을 섬긴 죄 때문에 벌을 받을 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the Lord GOD: the refrain, with the fuller name
decisions.reason: The refrain (see 6:7) here has "the Lord GOD", as in 13:9 and 24:24.

decisions.choice: bear the sins of your idols: suffer the punishment for idolatry
decisions.reason: As in verse 35, to "bear" sin is to bear its penalty.

decisions.choice: Your lewdness will be repaid on you
alternatives: they will bring your lewdness back on you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "they will put" has no named subject; Balanced and Readable put it in the passive.

decisions.choice: that I am the Lord GOD: 내가 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form of the refrain with the fuller name: 인 reads right after both forms of the span.
